amd-pur-2026-03.title: AMD-PUR-2026-03 Amendment 3 to the Purchase Policy
amd-pur-2026-03.summary: Amendment reducing the direct purchase order threshold from £50,000 to £25,000 gross effective 1 December 2026.
sources: 09_email_archive/2026/2026-10-12_Amendment 3 - direct orders limited to _25,000 from 1 December.eml

conflicts.today: Direct orders without a purchase request are permitted up to £50,000 gross until 30 November 2026.
conflicts.other: From 1 December 2026, direct orders without a request are restricted to a maximum of £25,000 gross.

r1.loc_text: sheet Log, row NBC-2026-026, SHEET Log
r1.quote: change=NBC-2026-026 | date=2026-11-30 | object=PUR.DIR_LIMIT | what=PLANNED: set to 25000 in the evening (AMD-PUR-2026-03) | by=JFLETCHER

r2.file: 09_email_archive/2026/2026-10-12_Amendment 3 - direct orders limited to _25,000 from 1 December.eml
r2.quote: Until 30 November it stays at £50,000.

r3.file: 09_email_archive/2026/2026-10-12_Amendment 3 - direct orders limited to _25,000 from 1 December.eml
r3.quote: From 1 December 2026 a direct order without a request is allowed only up to £25,000 gross.

r4.file: 09_email_archive/2026/2026-10-12_Amendment 3 - direct orders limited to _25,000 from 1 December.eml
r4.quote: IT changes Ledgerline on the evening of 30 November.

r5.quote: 1.0 2026-10-12 D. Okafor Issued; in force from 1 December 2026

r6.quote: A direct purchase order without a request is allowed only when its gross value, including VAT, is £25,000 or less.

r7.quote: Until 30 November 2026 the limit in §3.3 stays at £50,000.

r8.quote: The internal audit of the first half of 2026-27 found 212 direct orders between £25,000 and £50,000, many of them repeat orders

r9.quote: IT will change the direct-order limit in Ledgerline from £50,000 to £25,000 on the evening of 30 November 2026

r10.quote: From 1 December, a direct order above £25,000 gross will be refused with ERR-PO-0610.

r11.quote: Direct orders saved before 1 December are not affected.

amd-sup-2026-02.title: AMD-SUP-2026-02 Amendment 2 to the Supplier Policy
amd-sup-2026-02.summary: Amendment to POL-SUP-003 tightening UN 38.3 battery certificate validity to within 12 months of issue and 60 days post-order.
sources: 09_email_archive/2026/2026-10-23_RE_ Brightcell quote - can we switch from Voltway_.eml

conflicts.today: A UN 38.3 certificate is accepted only if issued within the last 12 months and valid for at least 60 days after purchase order placement.
conflicts.other: Certificates issued within 24 months and not expired were accepted under POL-SUP-003 §4.4; orders placed from 1 September 2026 without the new criteria count as having no certificate.

r1.quote: AMD-SUP-2026-02 Version 1.0 Effective 2026-09-01 Owner Purchase department, Northbridge Cycles Status CURRENT

r2.quote: With effect from 1 September 2026, Supplier Policy POL-SUP-003 §4.4 is replaced by the following: "A UN 38.3 certificate is accepted only if it was issued within the last 12 months, and its valid-to date is at least 60 days after the date the order is placed."

r3.quote: A certificate that meets the old rule (issued within 24 months and not expired) but not the new one counts as no certificate for new orders from 1 September 2026.

r4.quote: In July 2026 a battery pack lot from a supplier with a 22-month-old test report failed our own incoming abuse test. The cell maker had changed in the meantime.

r5.loc_text: p. 1, §3. What purchase staff must do
r5.quote: Before raising an order for a lithium-cell part, check the certificate's issue date and its valid-to date against the new rule.

r6.loc_text: p. 1, §3. What purchase staff must do
r6.quote: The senior buyer runs the certificate-expiry report (MAN-PUR-72 §22.6) on the first working day of each month with 90 days as the window, and writes to every supplier whose UN 38.3 certificate expires inside it.

r7.loc_text: p. 1, §3. What purchase staff must do
r7.quote: Every other part of POL-SUP-003 §4 stands.

r8.quote: If no new report has arrived 60 days before expiry, send a second reminder and tell the purchase manager. Under AMD-SUP-2026-02 no new order may be raised once fewer than 60 days remain.

r9.quote: Luis: draft Amendment 2 to the Supplier Policy, incorporating the 12-month window and the 60-day margin.

r10.quote: it checks only the valid-to date, not the 12-month and 60-day rules of AMD-SUP-2026-02.

r11.file: 09_email_archive/2026/2026-10-23_RE_ Brightcell quote - can we switch from Voltway_.eml
r11.quote: Since September the report must be less than 12 months old and valid for at least 60 days after the order (AMD-SUP-2026-02).

data-intranet-contacts-2016.title: NBC Intranet Contacts Directory (2016 Export)
data-intranet-contacts-2016.summary: Legacy 2016 intranet contacts directory covering operational routing, support escalation, and site administration for Manchester and Leeds.

r1.quote: This internal directory sets out the appropriate contact routes for staff across the Manchester factory and the Leeds unit.

r2.quote: Staff requiring support with the business system should log their query through the internal help desk rather than telephoning the IT room directly.

r3.quote: Ledgerline administration requests, password resets, and hardware faults are handled in order of receipt, with priority given to manufacturing stoppages and dispatch desk terminals.

r4.quote: staff must provide the relevant batch or order details alongside their site location so the duty technician can investigate the issue beforehand.

r5.quote: Queries relating to parts deliveries, carrier bookings, and warehouse transfers between Manchester and Leeds should be directed to the dispatch office at the sending location.

r6.quote: If a delivery dispute arises with a supplier or a haulage contractor, the matter must be referred to the purchasing desk

r7.quote: For direct inquiries from bike shops regarding account status, bicycle shipments, or warranty returns, customer service representatives should be contacted using the internal sales line.

r8.quote: Matters concerning wages, overtime sheets, and annual leave balances are dealt with by the accounts office in Manchester.

r9.quote: Urgent safety concerns or physical building issues must be reported to the works maintenance office immediately.

r10.quote: Last modified 03/11/2016 by DRAMSDEN. Exported from the old intranet (NBC-INTRANET01) in 2019 before it was switched off.

decision-2015-02-16-ledgerline-7-migrati.title: Decision 2015-02-16 Ledgerline 7 Migration Preparation
decision-2015-02-16-ledgerline-7-migrati.summary: February 2015 purchasing department instructions and cutover preparation for migrating to Ledgerline 7 to resolve cross-site duplicate entries.

r1.quote: The old arrangement for logging orders and checking supplier invoices has caused duplicate entries between Manchester and Leeds, and this change should keep everything in one place.

r2.quote: Before the changeover goes ahead, we need every outstanding purchase order checked against the paper records. Please ensure that all recent receipts of frames, motors, and batteries have been marked off

r3.quote: Once the transition starts, the old ledger will be set to read-only, so please raise any urgent orders immediately.

decision-2019-01-12-po-printer-replaceme.title: Decision 2019-01-12: Replacement printer for purchase orders
decision-2019-01-12-po-printer-replaceme.summary: Operational decision directing printed purchase orders to the dedicated purchasing office printer from 12 January 2019.

r1.quote: all printed purchase documentation and supplier copies should be directed to this device rather than the old machine

r2.quote: IT support desk has remapped the default print queue in the legacy enterprise software

r3.quote: print trays have been loaded with the approved pre-printed company letterhead and plain backing paper

decision-2019-03-06-retail-packaging-cha.title: Decision 2019-03-06 Retail packaging change
decision-2019-03-06-retail-packaging-cha.summary: Decision of 6 March 2019 adopting heavier outer cartons and pre-formed pulp trays for retail accessory packaging.

r1.quote: Following the feedback from several bike shops regarding carton damage during transit, we are going to amend the retail packaging specification

r2.quote: We are moving to a heavier grade of outer carton and replacing the folded dividers with pre-formed pulp trays.

r3.quote: This should keep the contents secure, stop the cables chafing against the painted brackets, and allow the cartons to stack cleanly

r4.quote: We will run down the existing carton stock before introducing the new boxes, so the changeover should be smooth.

decision-2022-10-16-purchasing-meeting.title: Weekly purchasing meeting - 2022-10-16
decision-2022-10-16-purchasing-meeting.summary: Operational decisions and actions from the 2022-10-16 weekly purchasing meeting on deliveries, quality, transfer bookings, price uplifts, and freight booking slots.

r1.quote: Date: 2022-10-16. Present: Rhys Pryce, Isla Morgan, Marta Kowalski, Kwame Mensah, Joanna Fletcher.

r2.quote: deliveries of wiring harnesses and motor mountings continue to arrive behind schedule. The supplier has cited staffing constraints at their own works

r3.quote: Contact the wiring harness supplier to demand a revised delivery timetable for the remaining orders on the system.

r4.quote: several consignments showing burrs that prevent correct seating during final fitting. The unit in Leeds has had to reject several crates

r5.quote: Arrange an on-site review with the stamping firm's technical representative at the Leeds unit to inspect the rejected crates.

r6.quote: transfers between the main Manchester warehouse and the sub-assembly lines are not being booked out at the time of movement

r7.quote: Remind the stores supervisors that all transfer tickets must be entered into the system before the close of each shift.

r8.quote: purchasing cannot accept the revised terms without prior consultation, as existing forward orders were placed under the annual agreement.

r9.quote: The road haulier currently contracted for palletised freight has missed several morning booking slots at Manchester, resulting in wagons being turned away

r10.quote: Review the delivery logs with the transport contractor and reinforce the requirement to book slots in advance.

r11.quote: The standard trade supplier no longer holds these belts in local depots, meaning orders must be routed through a specialist distributor.

decision-2022-10-21-supplier-review.title: Supplier Review Meeting (2022-10-21)
decision-2022-10-21-supplier-review.summary: Operational review addressing frame delivery paperwork, freight terms, quarantine returns congestion, and prompt purchase order schedule recording.

infobox.Attendees: Bronwen Price, Callum Shaw, Isla Morgan, Rhys Pryce
infobox.Topics: Delivery documentation, invoice surcharges, quarantine holding

r1.quote: Date: 2022-10-21. Present: Bronwen Price, Callum Shaw, Isla Morgan, Rhys Pryce.

r2.quote: pallet loads from primary frame vendors have frequently arrived without the standard printed delivery documentation attached, which creates delays at the Manchester goods receiving bay

r3.quote: Review open order freight terms with suppliers to eliminate delivery surcharge discrepancies prior to invoice receipt (Marion).

r4.quote: carrier collection arrangements for returned stock have been slow, causing congestion in the Leeds quarantine holding area.

r5.quote: Ensure all manual amendments to purchase order schedules are recorded promptly against the core ledger files (Keith).

decision-2023-03-02-production-planning.title: Production Planning Meeting - 2023-03-02
decision-2023-03-02-production-planning.summary: Production planning decisions from 2 March 2023 covering hardware transfer logging, torque wrench checks, dispatch flagging, and Leeds extraction maintenance.

infobox.Attendees: Stefan Berg, Bronwen Price, Marta Kowalski, Grace Whitaker, Emma Clarke, Callum Shaw

r1.quote: Date: 2023-03-02. Present: Stefan Berg, Bronwen Price, Marta Kowalski, Grace Whitaker, Emma Clarke, Callum Shaw.

r2.quote: Operations reported that frame preparation at the Manchester plant continues to run ahead of sub-assembly, which is causing congestion near the paint area.

r3.quote: Leeds reported steady output on wheel building, but highlighted that rims delivered by the carrier over recent days showed inconsistent spoke-hole deburring, requiring manual fettling

r4.quote: Stores noted that stock reconciliations between physical bins and the central system remain out of step for smaller hardware items, particularly cable guides and crank bolts.

r5.quote: Stores requested that assembly leads record any stock movements between departments on the paper transfer sheets immediately, rather than waiting until the end of the shift.

r6.quote: Purchasing stated that the principal battery supplier has warned of delayed consignments due to cell container availability at their port of departure.

r7.quote: Quality emphasised that until the paper sheets are initialled, completed bicycles cannot receive final sign-off tags, leading to finished goods lingering at the end of the line

r8.quote: Sales asked production control to ensure that works orders marked for direct collection are flagged clearly on the dispatch board to avoid accidental consolidation into regular carrier runs.

r9.quote: Production agreed that this maintenance must take place between shifts to avoid halting prep work entirely.

decision-2023-06-21-packaging-review.title: Packaging Review Meeting Notes (2023-06-21)
decision-2023-06-21-packaging-review.summary: Operational decisions and action items from the 21 June 2023 packaging review meeting addressing carton damage, transit issues, and sustainable materials.

r1.quote: Date: 2023-06-21. Present: Joanna Fletcher, Grace Whitaker, Aiko Tanaka, Marta Kowalski, Pieter Jansen, Stefan Berg.

r2.quote: Several independent bike shops have reported crushed corners on delivery, particularly where consignments were double-stacked by the carrier during regional distribution.

r3.quote: Marcus noted that dispatch staff in Manchester have taken to adding manual tape banding, but this slows the packing line and looks untidy

r4.quote: Following changes to warehouse layouts in Manchester, bulk packaging deliveries have occasionally blocked gangways near goods inwards, creating problems for assembly line

r5.quote: the Leeds unit ran short of battery packaging sleeves recently because split deliveries between the two sites were not tracked clearly.

r6.quote: When crated e-bikes are secured onto timber bases, certain frame sizes project slightly beyond the timber edge.

r7.quote: David also observed that internal cardboard fittings around the handlebars often shift during road transit if the secondary fixing wedges are omitted

r8.quote: Retailers continue to request reductions in single-use plastic bags used for manuals, pedals, and cable ties.

r9.quote: Clare to draft a proposal for unbleached paper envelopes and folding card dividers for the accessory packs.

decision-2024-05-08-leeds-unit-update.title: Leeds Unit Update Meeting - 8 May 2024
decision-2024-05-08-leeds-unit-update.summary: Operational decisions from the 8 May 2024 Leeds unit review covering crate delivery notes, frame staging, rework tracking, carrier timing, and maintenance parts.

infobox.Attendees: Emma Clarke, Stefan Berg, Rhys Pryce
infobox.Topic: Inter-site transfers, staging, rework stock records, and dispatch

r1.quote: Date: 2024-05-08. Present: Emma Clarke, Stefan Berg, Rhys Pryce.

r2.quote: Delivery notes sent across on the carrier do not always match the physical contents of the crates, which creates discrepancies

r3.quote: Check the packing line processes in Manchester and confirm transfer paperwork is signed off before the carrier departs.

r4.quote: It was agreed that frames must be moved promptly into the designated holding pens once inspection is complete.

r5.quote: when assemblies are split for rework, the stock records do not reflect the movement until the weekly reconciliation batch is processed

r6.quote: Review the entry steps for rework items with the ledger office to keep stock availability accurate between sites.

err-apr-0009.title: ERR-APR-0009 No approver found
err-apr-0009.summary: Error code displayed by Ledgerline when an order value exceeds the plant head approval ceiling of £5,000,000.

err-bin-0001.title: ERR-BIN-0001 Location not found or invalid format
err-bin-0001.summary: Ledgerline error indicating an unrecognised location reference, invalid formatting, or validation failure during bin service operations.

r1.quote: ERR-BIN-0001: This error message indicates that the system cannot complete the requested operation because the specified location reference cannot be found, contains invalid formatting

r2.quote: check that WHS CD matches the authorised plant or unit code, verify that BIN CD has been typed without typographical errors

err-bkf-0001.title: ERR-BKF-0001: Works order invalid or not in valid state for backflush
err-bkf-0001.summary: Ledgerline ERP error indicating an invalid, unreleased, closed, or held works order, or missing mandatory serial numbers during backflush.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: This message indicates that Ledgerline ERP 7.2 cannot locate the works order specified in the field WO NO, or that the works order is not in a valid state to receive backflush transactions.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: The validation routine will stop the transaction and display message ERR-BKF-0001 or prevent bkf_post from completing until all mandatory quality and tracking elements linked to the works order have been registered.

err-bkf-0007.title: ERR-BKF-0007: Component inventory shortage during backflush
err-bkf-0007.summary: Ledgerline error code indicating a bill of materials component inventory shortage at the line warehouse during backflush posting.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: This error is returned by the BACKFLUSH POST service when Ledgerline encounters an inventory shortage for one or more constituent components required by the bill of materials.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Once system balances match physical parts on the line, re-run the BACKFLUSH POST service.

r2.quote: <ll:error code="ERR-BNK-0001" msg="SUPPLIER BANK DETAILS NOT FOUND"/>

r3.quote: <ll:error code="ERR-BNK-0001" msg="SUPPLIER BANK DETAILS NOT FOUND"/>

err-bnk-0101.title: ERR-BNK-0101 Supplier bank details unverified
err-bnk-0101.summary: Ledgerline error that excludes suppliers with unverified bank details from the payment proposal generated by JOB-AP-030.

infobox.Remedy: Verify pending supplier bank paperwork with procurement

r2.section: Actions when something does not look right

err-bnk-0118.title: ERR-BNK-0118 Modulus check or clearing code validation failed

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: ERR-BNK-0118: Modulus check or clearing code validation failed. This indicates that the entry in field SORT CD or field ACCT NO fails the standard domestic clearing algorithm

err-bnk-0125.title: ERR-BNK-0125 Record locked by another user or concurrent payment process
err-bnk-0125.summary: Error raised when an AP vendor record is locked by another user session or an active payment generation run.

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: ERR-BNK-0125: Record locked by another user or concurrent payment process. This message appears when a user attempts to retrieve, save, or block a record that is currently open in another session

err-bom-0001.title: ERR-BOM-0001 Parent assembly not found on bill of materials master
err-bom-0001.summary: Production error raised when a parent assembly or work order item lacks an active bill of materials master record.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: This message indicates that the parent assembly entered in the PARENT field cannot be found on the bill of materials master file.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: This indicates that the ITEM CD entered does not have an active, signed-off bill of materials attached within the engineering register.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: Verify the item reference against the item master file or use bom_search to locate existing structures.

err-bom-0120.title: ERR-BOM-0120 Circular or recursive bill of materials structure detected
err-bom-0120.summary: Ledgerline error ERR-BOM-0120 halts processing when a circular or recursive bill of materials structure is detected.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: This message indicates that a recursive or circular structure has been detected during processing.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Ledgerline halts the transaction to prevent infinite processing loops. Operators must examine the component list and remove any component code that matches the parent or appears higher in the product hierarchy.

err-bom-0201.title: ERR-BOM-0201 Component line missing or invalid data
err-bom-0201.summary: Ledgerline error when saving a bill of materials line with missing, non-numeric, or zero quantity per assembly or invalid scrap percentage.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: This message indicates that the component line cannot be processed because required line data is missing or out of valid range.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Check each line in the entry grid to ensure that valid values exist in both QTY PER and SCRAP %, then press bom_save again.

err-cal-0001.title: ERR-CAL-0001 Calibration Tool Not Found
err-cal-0001.summary: Validation error raised when a keyed gauge number does not match an active tool record in the database.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: The system displays ERR-CAL-0001 when the value typed into GAUGE NO does not match any active tool record in the database.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: If the gauge is newly acquired, the quality supervisor must first set up the asset shell before calibration entries can be saved.

err-cc-0009.title: ERR-CC-0009
err-cc-0009.summary: Ledgerline Accounts Payable error indicating an invalid, missing, or inactive cost centre code entered in the CC CD field.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: ERR-CC-0009: Cost centre code invalid or inactive. This indicates that the value entered in CC CD does not exist within the current chart of accounts or has been flagged as closed

err-cc-0310.title: ERR-CC-0310 Cost centre has open documents
err-cc-0310.summary: Ledgerline error blocking cost centre closure when open purchase requisitions, incomplete purchase orders, or unposted goods receipts remain attached.
sources: 02_procedures/SOP-FIN-001 Cost Centre Open and Close v1.1.pdf

r1.file: 02_procedures/SOP-FIN-001 Cost Centre Open and Close v1.1.pdf
r1.quote: A cost centre with open documents cannot be closed (ERR-CC-0310) until they are moved or cancelled.

r2.file: 02_procedures/SOP-FIN-001 Cost Centre Open and Close v1.1.pdf
r2.quote: Leaving open purchase requisitions, incomplete purchase orders, or unposted goods receipts allocated to the cost centre. The software treats any unfinished document as an active commitment and prevents closure, returning ERR-CC-0310.

r3.file: 02_procedures/SOP-FIN-001 Cost Centre Open and Close v1.1.pdf
r3.section: What to do when something does not look right
r3.loc_text: p. 4, What to do when something does not look right
r3.quote: If Ledgerline displays ERR-CC-0310 during closure, run the commitment enquiry to identify every open document tied to the cost centre. Contact the originators immediately so they can cancel redundant orders or transfer ongoing commitments

err-ccp-0001.title: ERR-CCP-0001 Cycle count plan parameter error
err-ccp-0001.summary: Ledgerline error raised when cycle count plan parameters fail validation due to invalid warehouse, category, scheduling data, or active duplicate plans.

r1.quote: It occurs if the entered warehouse code does not exist or is currently locked, if the inventory classification entered in the field ABC CLASS is not recognised by the system tables, or if mandatory scheduling data is missing

r2.quote: Check that the warehouse in the field WHS CD is open and valid, confirm that the inventory classification is entered correctly, verify that the field FREQUENCY contains a valid operational setting

err-cnt-0230.title: ERR-CNT-0230 Area has open transactions
err-cnt-0230.summary: Ledgerline error raised on screen INV-CNT-06 when attempting to freeze a stock count area containing open transactions.

r1.quote: Ledgerline refuses to freeze an area with open transactions (ERR-CNT-0230).

r2.section: What to check on the screen
r2.loc_text: p. 4, What to check on the screen
r2.quote: The count screen will not lock the area until stores clerks have either completed or cancelled every open movement for those bays.

err-cnt-0240.title: ERR-CNT-0240 Cycle Count Value Variance Exceeds Tolerance
err-cnt-0240.summary: Ledgerline error raised when count sheet value variance exceeds the INV.CNT_TOL_PCT threshold, locking sheet posting until a recount is performed.

r1.quote: Any count entry where the total value variance exceeds the new default threshold is stopped immediately at the validation stage. The application will not commit the line, and the operator is presented with error ERR-CNT-0240 on the count confirmation screen.

r2.quote: The interface locks the posting action for that sheet, flags the item line for verification, and requires a recount before the batch can proceed to final adjustment and nominal ledger posting.

err-com-0001.title: ERR-COM-0001 Period Not Open or Already Posted
err-com-0001.summary: Ledgerline error raised during com_run when PERIOD is not open for commission processing or is already posted and locked.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf

infobox.Message: Period Not Open or Already Posted

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: This message appears when the value entered in the PERIOD field does not match an open commission cycle or represents an accounting period that has already been posted and locked.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Check with the accounts department to verify that the period has been opened for commission processing. If the period was entered incorrectly, clear the PERIOD field, re-enter the correct identifier, and click com_run again.

err-crd-0001.title: ERR-CRD-0001 Missing mandatory remarks for credit release
err-crd-0001.summary: Validation error raised in Ledgerline when attempting a credit release with a blank or invalid COMMENT field.

r1.quote: This message indicates that the system is unable to process a release request because mandatory remarks are absent.

err-crd-0207.title: ERR-CRD-0207 Customer Credit Limit Exceeded
err-crd-0207.summary: Error raised on screen SAL-SO-01 when confirming an order that exceeds the customer's credit limit.

infobox.Action: Contact accounts to review ledger or adjust status

r1.quote: Confirmation runs the credit check (ERR-CRD-0207 if the limit is exceeded).

r2.loc_text: p. 4, §5. Procedure: notes and common mistakes
r2.quote: When the credit check error displays upon order confirmation, do not attempt to force the order through. Inform the accounts department so they can review the bike shop ledger

err-csg-0001.title: ERR-CSG-0001 CONSIGNMENT STOCK NOT FOUND
err-csg-0001.summary: Ledgerline error ERR-CSG-0001 CONSIGNMENT STOCK NOT FOUND raised when consignment records are missing or parameters are inconsistent during save or settlement.

r1.quote: This message indicates a general consignment validation failure. It occurs when a user attempts to execute csg_save or csg_settle without completing all mandatory entries

r2.quote: ERR-CSG-0001 CONSIGNMENT STOCK NOT FOUND

err-csg-0201.title: ERR-CSG-0201 QTY MUST BE > 0 / Invalid Consignment Status
err-csg-0201.summary: Ledgerline error ERR-CSG-0201 raised during consignment settlement when the record status is invalid, frozen, or the settlement quantity is invalid.

conflicts.today: In §20 Messages table, ERR-CSG-0201 is listed with text 'QTY MUST BE > 0'
conflicts.other: On p. 66 Messages, ERR-CSG-0201 describes invalid record status (fully settled, cancelled, frozen) or settlement quantity exceeding remaining balance

r1.quote: This message indicates an invalid consignment status error. It appears when pressing csg_settle against a record that is already marked fully settled, cancelled, or frozen by central finance.

r2.quote: ERR-CSG-0201 QTY MUST BE > 0

err-cur-0001.title: ERR-CUR-0001 Currency Rate Action Failed
err-cur-0001.summary: Ledgerline error displayed when currency lookup or saving fails due to missing rates, invalid codes, locked periods, or table locks.

r1.quote: ERR-CUR-0001: This error message indicates that the system is unable to complete the requested currency rate action.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Check the spelling of the entry in the CUR CD field. Verify that the currency has been properly configured in the master accounts payable configuration.

err-cus-0001.title: ERR-CUS-0001 Mandatory Field Missing or Invalid in Customer Master
err-cus-0001.summary: Ledgerline error raised when saving or updating a customer record with missing mandatory fields or invalid country or payment term codes.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: ERR-CUS-0001: This notification indicates that a mandatory entry is absent or that the information entered does not satisfy basic formatting rules during the execution of CUSTOMER MASTER SAVE or CUSTOMER MASTER UPDATE.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Verify that the country identifier contains the exact required territory code, ensure that the payment term code exists within the sales parameter tables, and re-enter any missing text.

err-cus-0801.title: ERR-CUS-0801 Invalid or Duplicate VAT Number
err-cus-0801.summary: Ledgerline error when customer VAT registration format fails validation or duplicates an active trading account.

r1.quote: ERR-CUS-0801: This error message appears during customer creation or update when the value provided in VAT number fails tax format checks, or when the system detects an existing active account already trading under that identical registration.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: inspect the registration string for typographical errors or misplaced characters. If the number is typed accurately, invoke cust_search to verify whether another branch or earlier account for the retailer already exists

err-dbn-0001.title: ERR-DBN-0001
err-dbn-0001.summary: Ledgerline error raised when a debit note cannot be found during retrieval or when entering a zero balance in AP-DBN-04.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: This message indicates that the debit note record could not be found by the system. It occurs when a user enters an unrecognised reference into the DBN NO field

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: This message appears when a user attempts to execute the dbn_post or dbn_cancel service on a record that has already been processed.

err-dbn-0801.title: ERR-DBN-0801

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: If the reference in REF DOC has already been settled or does not exist, Ledgerline returns ERR-DBN-0801.

err-dlg-0210.title: ERR-DLG-0210 Delegate role lower than delegator
err-dlg-0210.summary: Error raised on SYS-DLG-03 when delegating approval authority to a user holding a lower role rank in the security hierarchy.

r1.quote: Ledgerline refuses a delegate whose role is lower than the delegator's (ERR-DLG-0210).

r2.quote: If the intended substitute occupies a post with lower standing, the interface rejects the entry and displays the validation prompt indicating that the delegate must hold the same or a higher role, accompanied by error reference ERR-DLG-0210.

r3.quote: The record cannot be committed to the database while this mismatch persists.

err-dlv-0320.title: ERR-DLV-0320 Lithium Battery Label Required
err-dlv-0320.summary: Error blocking despatch posting for battery packs until lithium battery labels are printed, requiring supervisor intervention to clear the transaction flag.

conflicts.today: To resolve ERR-DLV-0320, the user must contact the system supervisor to clear the transaction flag before reprinting
conflicts.other: The user navigates directly to label printing, generates the lithium battery label, and retries posting the despatch note without supervisor flag-clearing

r1.quote: Every parcel with a battery pack needs the lithium battery label printed before the despatch is posted (ERR-DLV-0320).

r2.loc_text: p. 4, §5. Procedure: notes and common mistakes
r2.quote: If the despatch error message appears during despatch posting, check whether the parcel contains a battery pack. Return to the label printing option, generate the lithium battery label, and then retry posting the despatch note.

r3.quote: Print the label before posting the despatch (ERR-DLV-0320).

r4.loc_text: p. 1, Despatch sequence in the system
r4.quote: Always print the label before posting the despatch transaction. If this error appears, contact the system supervisor to clear the transaction flag before reprinting.

ERR-DMO-0001

r2.quote: ERR-DMO-0001: General demonstration loan validation error. This message indicates that required header information is absent or malformed.

err-dmo-0801.title: ERR-DMO-0801 DEMO BIKE CLOSED (<status>)
err-dmo-0801.summary: Ledgerline error ERR-DMO-0801 indicates a demo bike record state conflict when attempting to modify, close, or allocate an invalid loan record.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote:
ERR-DMO-0801
DEMO BIKE CLOSED (<status>)

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: This message appears when the frame entered in SERIAL NO is already tied to an open demonstration movement.

err-dsc-0001.title: ERR-DSC-0001
err-dsc-0001.summary: Error raised when a discount operation fails validation, lacks a matching discount record, or encounters an invalid customer account.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: ERR-DSC-0001: This message is returned by the system when a failure occurs during validation or retrieval of a discount record. In plain words, this indicates that the system was unable to complete the requested discount operation

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: When ERR-DSC-0001 appears, the transaction is rejected, no changes are saved to the pricing tables, and the screen remains in its prior state.

err-ecn-0220.title: ERR-ECN-0220 Open Work Orders on Revision
err-ecn-0220.summary: Error triggered when attempting to release an engineering change while active work orders or unfinished kitting lists remain open on the earlier revision.

r1.quote: Ledgerline refuses to release an ECN while work orders are open on the old revision (ERR-ECN-0220).

r2.loc_text: p. 4, §5. Procedure: notes and common mistakes
r2.quote: generate the live assembly listing to trace the exact order numbers preventing the release. Liaise directly with production control to determine whether those jobs must be completed under the existing revision

err-edi-0101.title: ERR-EDI-0101 Partner Not Set Up
err-edi-0101.summary: Error raised when an incoming EDI transmission sender trading partner identifier is not linked to an active sales ledger account.

r1.quote: Where the account itself is not recognised, the interface refuses the transmission with ERR-EDI-0101. This indicates that the sender trading partner identifier has not been linked to an active sales ledger account.

r2.quote: Sales administrators must verify that the retailer has an open, approved credit account, ensure the electronic trading flags are enabled on the account record, and associate the partner identifier before clearing the entry.

err-edi-0140.title: ERR-EDI-0140 Unknown Buyer Item Code
err-edi-0140.summary: Inbound EDI error raised when an incoming customer item code cannot be mapped to a Northbridge finished bicycle or frame part.

r1.quote: Where an unknown buyer item code is identified, the interface rejects the line with ERR-EDI-0140.

r2.quote: Sales staff must check the customer mapping table in the sales order module, insert the missing item translation, and reprocess the pending record.

err-frt-0501.title: ERR-FRT-0501 Carrier interface failure
err-frt-0501.summary: Carrier interface failure error raised when Ledgerline cannot validate consignment routing or format label requests for a carrier.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: ERR-FRT-0501: Carrier interface failure. Ledgerline was unable to validate the consignment route or format the label request for the service indicated in CARRIER.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Check the network link to the freight service or confirm that the carrier code assigned to the customer account is currently operational.

err-gl-0001.title: ERR-GL-0001 Missing or Invalid Header Information
err-gl-0001.summary: General ledger posting rejection raised when header data is missing or invalid, accounts are invalid or suspended, or debits and credits do not balance.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: ERR-GL-0001: This message indicates that the system has detected missing or invalid header information, or that an essential mandatory field has been left blank prior to executing the posting service.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: If the credits and debits do not balance, or if an account code is suspended, the system halts the service and returns message ERR-GL-0001.

err-gl-0007.title: ERR-GL-0007 Ledger Integrity Failure
err-gl-0007.summary: Ledgerline error code indicating a general ledger posting or reversal integrity check failure.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: ERR-GL-0007: This message indicates that the transaction cannot be committed because the Ledgerline ERP 7.2 validation service has found an integrity failure

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: This message appears during the posting action if the entered JV DT belongs to a closed ledger period, or if the user lacks posting rights for the specified general ledger section.

err-grn-0102.title: ERR-GRN-0102 Purchase order not released
err-grn-0102.summary: Ledgerline error raised during goods receipt when the referenced purchase order is not in released status.

infobox.Trigger: Attempting goods receipt against an unreleased purchase order
infobox.Remedy: Contact purchasing to release the order

r1.quote: Only released orders (RL) can be received; Ledgerline refuses others with ERR-GRN-0102.

r2.quote: When the system displays ERR-GRN-0102, contact the purchasing team to confirm the order status. Do not attempt to force the receipt or alter the reference on the screen.

err-grn-0204.title: ERR-GRN-0204 Over-receipt exceeds order balance
err-grn-0204.summary: Ledgerline error raised during goods receipt when the entered receipt quantity exceeds the open purchase order line balance.

r1.quote: You cannot receive more than the order's balance (ERR-GRN-0204).

r2.quote: When an over-delivery triggers ERR-GRN-0204, halt the transaction. Receive only the valid balance if instructed, or hold the entire delivery in the receiving bay while contacting purchasing.

err-inv-0118.title: ERR-INV-0118 Duplicate supplier invoice number
err-inv-0118.summary: Error raised by Ledgerline ERP when a supplier invoice reference already exists for the vendor account.

r1.quote: When purchase ledger staff enter a supplier reference that already exists for that vendor account, the system halts processing immediately and displays error ERR-INV-0118.

r2.quote: The document remains unposted, and the user must either correct the entry or cancel the transaction.

r3.quote: External interfaces must be configured to catch this specific validation response, log the offending transaction in the interface error queue, and alert the finance systems administrator

err-itm-0001.title: ERR-ITM-0001: Item code already exists in Item Master
err-itm-0001.summary: Error raised when attempting to save a new item record using an item code that already exists in the Item Master.

infobox.Remedy: Retrieve part and run itm_update, or allocate an unused reference

r1.quote: Plain words: The item code entered already exists in the Item Master database. Remedy: This error occurs when pressing itm_save for an item code that has previously been created.

r2.quote: If you intend to amend an existing part, retrieve the part first and use the itm_update button rather than attempting to save a new record. If creating a new part, confirm the numbering sequence and allocate an unused reference

err-itm-0011.title: ERR-ITM-0011 ITEM NOT FOUND OR INACTIVE
err-itm-0011.summary: Ledgerline error ERR-ITM-0011 raised when an item code does not exist in master records or holds an inactive status.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf

conflicts.today: ERR-ITM-0011 indicates that an entered item code does not exist in the item master or is inactive across inventory, production, and sales modules.
conflicts.other: MAN-INV-72 p. 43 states ERR-ITM-0011 indicates a missing mandatory field or invalid format during item master maintenance (requiring checks on DESCRIPTION, UOM, CATEGORY, LITHIUM CELL, REORDER LVL, and REASON).

r1.quote: ERR-ITM-0011: The value entered in ITEM CD does not exist in the item master ledger or has been marked as inactive.

r2.quote: Plain words: Mandatory field missing or invalid entry format detected. Remedy: Ledgerline requires valid data in every core field prior to committing a master record.

r3.quote: Ensure the ITEM CD, DESCRIPTION, UOM, and CATEGORY fields contain valid text, that the LITHIUM CELL (0/1) field contains only the allowed single-digit flag, and that the REORDER LVL contains a valid figure. When blocking a record, ensure the REASON field is not blank.

r4.quote: ERR-ITM-0011: The value entered in ITEM CD does not exist within the inventory master files or has been flagged as completely inactive.

r5.quote: This message indicates that the part reference stored against the card does not exist in the active parts master, or has been flagged as obsolete. Do not attempt to re-save the card.

r6.quote: This message indicates an item master discrepancy. It occurs when the value entered in the ITEM CD field does not exist within the Ledgerline inventory master records

r7.quote: ERR-ITM-0011 ITEM NOT FOUND OR INACTIVE

r8.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r8.quote: This message indicates that a component item reference entered in the COMPONENT field does not exist in the Ledgerline item master file or is currently marked with a status that prohibits production issue.

r9.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r9.quote: Operators must check the spelling of the part code, confirm that the item has been created in the item master, and verify that the item status is set to permit transactions.

r10.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r10.quote: ERR-ITM-0011: The item code entered in the ITM CD field does not exist in the item master database, or it has been flagged as an inactive or bought-out record.

r11.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r11.quote: The item code entered in ITEM CD does not exist within the active inventory item master, or it has been flagged as obsolete, superseded, or inactive.

r12.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r12.quote: Check the entry for typographical errors. Verify against engineering release sheets that the part code is active.

r13.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r13.quote: ERR-ITM-0011: This message appears during the execution of the scp_save service if the value entered in the ITEM CD field is invalid or not recognised on the master item file.

r14.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r14.quote: If the component was issued as a substitute not listed on the original bill of materials, contact production control to update the works order before attempting to save again.

r15.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r15.quote: ERR-ITM-0011: This message indicates that the value entered in the ITEM CD field cannot be validated against the active part master files. Plainly, the part identifier does not exist, has been typed incorrectly, or has been marked with an inactive or phased-out status in the system.

r16.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r16.quote: The item entered in the ITEM CD field is either not present in the master catalogue or has not been flagged as an active production item for internal manufacture.

r17.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r17.quote: ERR-ITM-0011: This condition indicates an invalid item code. The reference keyed into the ITEM CD field does not exist within the central part catalogue, or it has been flagged as deleted or inactive.

r18.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r18.quote: This message appears after pressing the button srl_reg if the value entered in the field ITEM CD does not exist within the finished goods master, or if the stock record has been marked as superseded or archived by the stock control office.

r19.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r19.quote: When this message displays, the registration is rejected and no database update takes place. The operator must cross-reference the workshop traveller with the current finished goods price list, correct the contents of the field ITEM CD, and press the button srl_reg again.

r20.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r20.quote:
ERR-ITM-0011
ITEM NOT FOUND OR INACTIVE

r21.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r21.quote: This warning indicates that the value keyed in ITEM CD does not match an active finished stock part in the central item master.

err-itm-0801.title: ERR-ITM-0801: Conversion factor invalid or calculation mismatch between units of measure
err-itm-0801.summary: ERR-ITM-0801 is raised during unit of measure conversion calculations or when committing an item block without an explanation.

conflicts.today: ERR-ITM-0801 indicates conversion factor errors or calculation overflow during itm_uom_conv
conflicts.other: Section Questions users ask states ERR-ITM-0801 is raised when itm_block is committed without a reason

r1.quote: This error is returned during execution of itm_uom_conv when the FROM UOM and TO UOM entries are identical, when the FACTOR field is left blank or set to an invalid mathematical character, or when the calculation would cause a numeric overflow

r2.quote: Check the ratio entered in the FACTOR field, ensure both unit codes are distinct and recognised by the system, and press the conversion button again.

r3.quote: The user attempted to commit itm_block (ITEM MASTER BLOCK) without recording an explanation in the REASON field.

err-kbn-0001.title: ERR-KBN-0001 Kanban Card Not Found or Duplicate Signal
err-kbn-0001.summary: Ledgerline error when a Kanban card record is missing, has a key conflict on save, or receives a duplicate replenishment signal.

r1.quote: ERR-KBN-0001: The system cannot locate the record requested through KBN NO, or a key conflict occurred during a save operation.

r2.quote: This error is triggered when a card is already in a signalled state. Check whether a colleague has already scanned the card or entered the request earlier in the shift.

err-kbn-0801.title: ERR-KBN-0801 Kanban Card Status Transition or Warehouse Validation Error
err-kbn-0801.summary: Ledgerline error code raised on invalid Kanban card transitions or unauthorized warehouse-item assignments.

r1.quote: ERR-KBN-0801: A processing error has occurred during a status transition, typically when pressing kbn_signal or kbn_close.

r2.quote: How is error ERR-KBN-0801 resolved during the kbn_save service? This error indicates a validation failure between the WHS CD and the ITEM CD, usually because the designated warehouse location is not authorised

err-lot-0001.title: ERR-LOT-0001 Duplicate lot or serial identifier
err-lot-0001.summary: Ledgerline error raised when a lot or serial identifier is already recorded in the database for the given item code.

r1.quote: ERR-LOT-0001: The identifier entered in LOT/SERIAL is already present in the database for this item. Ledgerline does not permit duplicate serial identities

err-lot-0007.title: ERR-LOT-0007 Lot or serial number not found
err-lot-0007.summary: Error ERR-LOT-0007 is raised by lot_get and lot_trace when a requested lot or serial number cannot be located for an item.

infobox.Message: Lot or serial number not found

r1.quote: ERR-LOT-0007: The requested lot or serial number cannot be located for the specified item code. This occurs when executing lot_get or lot_trace

err-lot-0301.title: ERR-LOT-0301 Lot locked or invalid status transition
err-lot-0301.summary: Ledgerline error raised when a lot action fails due to an active lock or an invalid lot status transition.

r1.quote: ERR-LOT-0301: The action cannot be completed because the lot is currently locked by another inventory transaction, or an invalid status transition was attempted

err-mat-0420.title: ERR-MAT-0420 Match override permission denied
err-mat-0420.summary: Error raised when an unauthorized user attempts to override an invoice match, requiring AP manager review.

r1.quote: Only the AP manager may override a match (ERR-MAT-0420 for anyone else). The reason goes in the override comment.

r2.loc_text: p. 4, Common mistakes when entering invoices
r2.quote: Retrying an override when the system displays ERR-MAT-0420. This message indicates that the user lacks the necessary permission.

err-mps-0001.title: ERR-MPS-0001 Missing Mandatory Field or Invalid Format in MPS
err-mps-0001.summary: Validation error raised by mps_save on PRD-MPS-05 when mandatory schedule fields are blank, invalid, out of calendar, or record-locked.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

infobox.Message: Missing Mandatory Field or Invalid Format in MPS

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: A mandatory field is missing, or the format of the specified week or quantity is invalid.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: when the entry in the WEEK field does not correspond to an open planning period in the production calendar, or when the schedule record for that specific timeframe is locked by another terminal.

err-mps-0201.title: ERR-MPS-0201 Master Schedule Line Locked Against Modification
err-mps-0201.summary: Ledgerline error raised when attempting to modify a locked master schedule line due to shop floor tracking, committed components, or a closed week.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

infobox.message: Master Schedule Line Locked Against Modification

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: The schedule line for this item and week is locked against modifications because production is already active or closed.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Adjustments to active build weeks must be handled via works order amendment routines rather than by overwriting the baseline master schedule.

err-mrp-0001.title: ERR-MRP-0001
err-mrp-0001.summary: Fatal MRP run execution error halting order generation due to invalid parameters, missing calendars, pending transactions, or circular BOM references.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: This error message indicates that the MRP calculation engine encountered an invalid parameter, missing calendar data, or an unresolvable circular reference within a bill of materials during the execution of the mrp_run service.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: When this error appears, the calculation halts, no planned orders are created, and the RUN ID is marked as aborted.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: The user must verify that the HORIZON field contains a valid entry, confirm that factory working calendars for both Manchester and Leeds are open for the entirety of the planning window, and check that no sub-assembly lists itself as a parent component.

err-opr-0001.title: ERR-OPR-0001: Operation confirmation conflict or invalid data
err-opr-0001.summary: Rejection error code raised during operation confirmation due to closed work orders, out-of-order routing sequences, or out-of-tolerance quantities.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: This typically occurs because the works order entered in WO NO does not exist, has already been closed, or is currently locked by another shop floor terminal.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: When ERR-OPR-0001 appears, no data has been saved. Clear the message, use opr_get to re-read the operation from the database

err-pay-0430.title: ERR-PAY-0430 Payment proposal approver cannot be proposer
err-pay-0430.summary: Error raised on AP-PAY-03 when the payment proposal approver is the same user who created or amended the proposal.

infobox.message: Payment proposal approver cannot be proposer

r1.loc_text: p. 3, §5. Procedure: notes and common mistakes
r1.quote: An accounts payable clerk who creates or amends the proposal cannot then sign it off. Doing so triggers error ERR-PAY-0430 and prevents the payment schedule from advancing.

r2.section: Actions when something does not look right
r2.loc_text: p. 4, Actions when something does not look right
r2.quote: If error ERR-PAY-0430 appears, ensure the user logs out and that the accounts payable manager logs in with their own credentials to conduct the independent review.

err-pcs-0001.title: ERR-PCS-0001
err-pcs-0001.summary: Validation error raised when mandatory petty cash fields OU CD, AMOUNT, PURPOSE, or CC CD are omitted.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: ERR-PCS-0001: Mandatory petty cash fields missing. This message appears when the PETTY CASH SAVE or PETTY CASH POST routines detect an empty field that requires data.

err-pcs-0007.title: ERR-PCS-0007
err-pcs-0007.summary: Ledgerline Accounts Payable error raised when saving or posting a locked or already posted petty cash voucher, or during period-end reconciliation lock.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: ERR-PCS-0007: Voucher already posted or locked. This message indicates that an attempt was made to run pcs_save or pcs_post against a transaction where the field STATUS is already set to posted.

err-per-0010.title: ERR-PER-0010 Documents unposted at period close
err-per-0010.summary: Ledgerline error blocking AP period close on screen AP-PER-11 when unposted documents, batches, journals, or matchings remain.

r1.quote: Ledgerline refuses the close while documents are unposted (ERR-PER-0010).

r2.section: What to do when something does not look right
r2.loc_text: p. 4, What to do when something does not look right
r2.quote: Return to the batch entry screens. Search for any batches with unposted status. Either complete the posting routine for valid entries or remove temporary draft batches. Once the queues are clear, return to AP-PER-11 and retry the close.

err-pkb-0001.title: ERR-PKB-0001 Primary Kanban Validation Failure
err-pkb-0001.summary: Error raised during production kanban entry or shop floor signalling when validation fails or a card is missing or already active.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

conflicts.today: ERR-PKB-0001 is described as a general primary kanban validation failure caused by missing mandatory fields, format issues, or non-existent cards
conflicts.other: ERR-PKB-0001 is defined as 'PRODUCTION KANBAN NOT FOUND' raised when signalling a card that has already been signalled and remains outstanding

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: ERR-PKB-0001: This message reports a primary kanban validation failure during processing. Plainly, the record cannot be created, retrieved, or signalled because a mandatory field is blank, the card reference format is invalid, or the entered card number does not exist within the system registers.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Check that PKB NO, ITEM CD, WORK CENTRE, and QTY contain valid data prior to pressing any action button.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: If the card has already been signalled and remains outstanding, the system rejects the duplicate action with message ERR-PKB-0001.

err-pkb-0201.title: ERR-PKB-0201 Duplicate Active Kanban Cycle
err-pkb-0201.summary: Production kanban error raised when an identical replenishment cycle is already active, with manual conflicts regarding work centres and zero quantity.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

conflicts.today: In message descriptions, ERR-PKB-0201 indicates an identical kanban cycle is already active for the card, item, and line location
conflicts.other: In the message catalogue, ERR-PKB-0201 is listed as 'QTY MUST BE > 0'

conflicts.today: In message descriptions, ERR-PKB-0201 indicates an active duplicate kanban cycle
conflicts.other: In user FAQ documentation, ERR-PKB-0201 indicates the work centre is closed, suspended, or invalid in the work centre master

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: ERR-PKB-0201: This message signals that a replenishment request cannot be transmitted because an identical kanban cycle is already active for that specific combination of card, item, and line location.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Do not re-enter the card. Check the collection bays and replenishment queues to establish whether the requested batch is already in transit.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: ERR-PKB-0201 QTY MUST BE > 0

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: This message appears if the work centre entered is marked as closed, suspended, or invalid for the selected item in the work centre master file.

err-pkg-0001.title: ERR-PKG-0001 Packaging information missing or unrecognised
err-pkg-0001.summary: Ledgerline error when packaging type is blank or invalid, or quantity is zero or outside entry rules.

infobox.Title: Supplier payment file: Standard 18 layout as used by Northbridge

r1.quote: Document INT-BNK-002 Version 1.3 Effective 2024-06-01 Owner Finance and IT Status CURRENT

r2.quote: The procedure replaces manual payment entries and covers trade creditors, utilities, and recurring service charges across both the Manchester factory and the Leeds unit.

r3.quote: Staff should never open or alter the export file in the spreadsheet package or text editors prior to transmission.

r4.quote: Always ensure supplier bank details are validated and saved in Ledgerline ERP well ahead of the settlement run. Check that the total value shown

r5.quote: 1-6 6 Destination sort code Supplier's bank 7-14 8 Destination account Zero-padded 15 1 Type 0

r6.quote: 16-17 2 Transaction code 99 for credit 18-23 6 Originating sort code Northbridge main account 24-31 8 Originating account

r7.quote: 36-46 11 Amount In pence, zero-padded 47-64 18 Originator name NORTHBRIDGE CYCLES 65-82 18 Reference AP run number 83-100 18 Beneficiary name Upper case

r8.quote: Payments to suppliers outside the UK are not in the STD18 file. They are keyed by hand into the bank's portal by the AP manager, from the run's foreign-payments list.

r9.quote: Once keyed, the entries require secondary release on the portal by an authorised signatory before the bank will execute the transfers.

r10.quote: Cross-check the beneficiary account details against the original signed purchase order or paper invoice, rather than relying solely on the screen display.

r29.file: 01_policies/POL-BAT-004 Battery Safety and Handling Policy v1.2.pdf
r29.quote: Packs are kept at a state of charge between 30% and 50% while in store. Stores staff must never charge a pack in the store.

r30.file: 01_policies/POL-BAT-004 Battery Safety and Handling Policy v1.2.pdf
r30.quote: A pack shipped on its own is sent as UN3480 (lithium-ion batteries). A pack fitted to a bike, or packed with it, is sent as UN3481. Every parcel with a pack carries the lithium battery handling label (item PKG-LBL-UN).

r31.quote: Lithium-cell parts are inspected at acceptable quality level (AQL) 0.65; all other parts at AQL 1.5. Every sample battery pack also gets an open-circuit voltage check

r32.quote: Battery packs are classified as hazardous freight and must be returned only through the carrier's dangerous-goods service with the UN3480 label affixed to the exterior of each approved crate.

r33.file: 02_procedures/SOP-INV-004 Battery Pack Storage and Handling v1.0.pdf
r33.quote: Put battery packs away only in fire cells BAT-Z1 to BAT-Z4. Check the cell's count board first: no more than 1,500 packs per cell (POL-BAT-004 §2.2).

r34.file: 02_procedures/SOP-PRD-001 Work Order Release and Backflush v1.5.pdf
r34.loc_text: p. 3, §5. Procedure: notes and common mistakes
r34.quote: Because battery packs require individual serial tracking, they do not clear through the standard backflush routine. Operators sometimes complete frames and electric assemblies on the system without booking the serial numbers through the manual material screen

r35.quote: Most run from 1 April to 31 March; contracts for battery packs may run for six months.

r36.quote: Without a valid test summary confirming compliance with the relevant transport testing requirements, battery stock cannot be legally moved by our freight carriers, stored at the Manchester works, or transferred to the Leeds unit.

r37.section: What to check on the screen
r37.loc_text: p. 4, What to check on the screen
r37.quote: Any change in cell chemistry, casing, or internal management circuitry requires a matching test document, not merely a covering letter.

r38.loc_text: p. 3, §5. Procedure: notes and common mistakes
r38.quote: Selecting cell packs or battery assemblies purely on low unit cost. For lithium-cell parts, technical compliance sits ahead of cost.

r39.quote: For every sample battery pack, record the open-circuit voltage. A pack below 30% state of charge or above 50% is rejected (POL-BAT-004 §2.3).

r40.loc_text: p. 4, §5. Procedure: notes and common mistakes
r40.quote: If any sample pack falls below 30% state of charge or above 50%, treat the entire lot as non-conforming in line with POL-BAT-004 §2.3. Do not re-sample or test additional units in an attempt to pass the consignment.

r41.quote: 5.1 Move the pack to the red quarantine bin in fire cell BAT-Z4 at once. Wear gloves and eye protection.

r42.quote: Battery packs are serial-tracked: every pack has its own serial number from the supplier's label, recorded at goods receipt.

r43.section: Sales: Carrier labels print the dangerous-goods service code
r43.loc_text: p. 2, Sales: Carrier labels print the dangerous-goods service code
r43.quote: omitted the service identifier required whenever shipments contained traction batteries or packaged power units.

r44.quote: Fire cells BAT-Z1 to BAT-Z4 in Manchester main stores No more than 1,500 packs per cell State of charge 30% to 50%

r45.quote: UN3480 for a pack alone UN3481 for a pack in or with a bike Carrier service DGX

r46.quote: Move the stock immediately to the designated storage area once the goods receipt record has been created.

r47.quote: Battery packs and loose cells require active safety documentation before purchase. Always verify that current paperwork is held on file before approving

man-adm-72.title: MAN-ADM-72 Ledgerline ERP 7.2 System Administration
man-adm-72.summary: System administration reference manual for Ledgerline ERP 7.2 covering security, parameters, sequences, batch processing, sessions, audit logging, and site operations across Manchester and Leeds.
sources: 09_email_archive/2026/2026-03-09_Ledgerline patch installed - sessions now time out after 15 minutes.eml

conflicts.today: As of patch 7.2.3-P2 installed on 8 March 2026, parameter SYS.SESSION_TIMEOUT defaults to 15 minutes, rolling back uncommitted entries cleanly when terminals drop out.
conflicts.other: Under base release 7.2.3, the system parameter idle threshold for user inactivity timeout was 20 minutes; user manuals were not updated when the patch changed the default.

r1.quote: Each user has exactly one role. The role decides which screens and services the user may use; the approval limit is stored on the user, not the role.

r2.quote: A delegation (SYS-DLG-03) gives another user the approval inbox of the delegator for a period. Ledgerline refuses a delegate whose role is lower than the delegator's (ERR-DLG-0210).

r3.quote: Parameters are maintained on SYS-PAR-04 (services par_get, par_set, par_list, par_hist).

r4.quote: Document numbers are given by sequence: PR/<year>/<five digits>, PO/<year>/<five digits>, GRN/<year>/<five digits>. Job JOB-SYS-020 starts the new year's sequences at 00:05 on 1 January.

r5.quote: Requisition entries reserve the next sequential identifier only upon submission for approval. Draft records do not consume references from the series.

r6.quote: Jobs are listed in MAN-BAT-72. Submit, monitor and cancel jobs on SYS-JOB-06.

r7.quote: Never attempt to terminate a running job through host operating system commands; always cancel the task formally within SYS-JOB-06 to allow Ledgerline ERP 7.2 to roll back partial postings cleanly.

r8.quote: Every service call is written to the audit trail with the time, user, service, payload, return code and error code. Rows older than 84 months are moved to the archive schema by JOB-SYS-012.

r9.quote: JOB-SYS-012 moves these records to the archive schema; they remain fully intact and retrievable, though they cannot be queried through standard day-to-day screens.

r10.quote: A service account is a user like any other: its role decides what it may call and its own approval limit applies.

r11.quote: If an automated process attempts to post a batch purchase adjustment or raise a standard stock reallocation that exceeds the approval ceiling assigned to its profile, the software rejects the transaction immediately.

r12.quote: The nightly backup (JOB-SYS-001) runs at 01:30. Ledgerline is read-only from 01:30 to 01:50.

r13.quote: However, the system rejects any attempt to post goods receipts, issue raw materials, or print dispatch notes until the background routine clears and full read-write privileges return.

r14.quote: It is also wrongly believed that read-only reporting tasks do not consume a licence; any active connection to the application interface draws an active token from the shared pool.

r15.quote: Always log out using the standard exit command in the main menu to ensure the session token releases immediately back to the pool.

r16.quote: Never leave idle sessions open over shift changes or tea breaks, particularly on shared terminals in the stores and assembly areas.

r17.quote: If a user receives a message stating that the connection limit is reached, contact the systems administrator to review the active session table

r18.quote: Ensure automated overnight report extracts finish before the early shift begins, avoiding licence contention with incoming shop-floor personnel.

r19.quote: The primary objective during any system failure is to protect ledger integrity first, clear physical congestion on the shop floor and despatch bays second

r20.quote: Under no circumstances should an administrator bypass standard record validation merely to allow operators to resume keying.

r21.quote: Manchester hosts the primary application and database environment, whilst Leeds operates via remote terminal sessions over the wide area link.

r22.quote: stores staff attempt a bulk goods receipt for motor assemblies or frame consignments while the purchase ledger team is running matching routines, the database engine will place exclusive holds

r23.quote: If the process holding the lock is performing active input, the administrator must contact the user directly before taking action.

r24.quote: If the session has terminated abnormally or the user has walked away, the administrator clears the orphaned process from the process table, allowing the deferred updates to roll back safely.

r25.quote: If a network blip occurs, Ledgerline ERP 7.2 halts the relevant print spooler entirely rather than retrying the print job.

r26.loc_text: p. 12, Common errors and bad practice
r26.quote: Terminating a session while the ledger engine is actively committing batch journals can leave tables out of balance, requiring a full sequential check of the transaction logs.

r27.loc_text: p. 13, Common errors and bad practice
r27.quote: Clearing the lock while the picking documentation is being generated results in duplicate consignments being prepared and despatched to the bike shop.

r28.loc_text: p. 13, Common errors and bad practice
r28.quote: This drops all active sessions in Leeds, corrupting any unfinished frame stock adjustments or battery serial number allocations.

r29.loc_text: p. 13, Common errors and bad practice
r29.quote: Doing so skips crucial periodic recalculations, such as standard cost rollovers and reorder level evaluations, causing subsequent replenishment suggestions to be completely inaccurate.

r30.quote: Always verify whether a reported lockup is genuine before intervening; ask the user to wait a moment to ensure a large reporting query is not simply running

r31.quote: The default idle-session timeout (parameter SYS.SESSION_TIMEOUT) changes from 20 to 15 minutes. The user manuals are not reissued for this change.

r32.quote: Locked user IDs are listed in the locked users report rather than appearing alongside active accounts within the general user maintenance screen.

r33.quote: Clear your workstation spool queue before leaving for the day. Print jobs left pending in the queue lock batch processes and slow down overnight reporting

r34.quote: Running repeated stock lookups alongside live purchase ledger screens consumes server memory and can cause the system to freeze during large receipting batches.

r35.quote: If the system warns of a record lock when you attempt to edit an order, check with the accounts department or goods inward before asking IT for assistance.

r36.quote: Amend the system parameter file so that the idle threshold adjusts from 20 to 15 minutes.

r37.quote: open records will not be corrupted, as the software rolls back uncommitted entries cleanly when a terminal drops out.

r38.quote: The schedule covers routine telephone assistance, patch releases for the current release, and access to their technical desk for both the Manchester factory and the Leeds unit.

r39.quote: The plant team in Manchester had several queries recently concerning batch posting delays, whilst the warehouse staff in Leeds reported occasional session drops when printing dispatch notes.

r40.quote: It also preserves our existing response levels for critical overnight processing failures, which remains essential given our current production volumes.

r41.file: 09_email_archive/2026/2026-03-09_Ledgerline patch installed - sessions now time out after 15 minutes.eml
r41.quote: Idle Ledgerline sessions now close after 15 minutes instead of 20.
