man-dd-72.title: MAN-DD-72 Ledgerline ERP 7.2 Data Dictionary, Purchasing
man-dd-72.summary: Data dictionary reference for Ledgerline ERP 7.2 purchasing payloads, tables, field formats, and core purchasing status and lookup codes.

r1.quote: Service responses come in an envelope with four fields: rc (return code: S for success, E for error), err_cd (the error code when rc is E), msg (a short message in capitals) and data (the result).

r2.quote: Dates in payloads are YYYY-MM-DD. Amounts are in pounds sterling with two decimals. Codes are capitals.

r3.quote: ou_cd (Organisation unit): NBC-MAN-01 is the Manchester plant; NBC-LDS-01 is the Leeds unit. Both are in the United Kingdom (country code GB).

r4.quote: state: two-letter country code of a supplier or organisation unit, for example GB (United Kingdom), NL (Netherlands), PL (Poland). The column keeps its 1998 name.

r5.quote: status (documents): DR, PA, AP, RL, RJ, CN, CL, as listed in the user manual (MAN-PUR-72 §16.1).

r6.quote: status (suppliers): ACTIVE or BLOCKED.

r7.quote: uom_cd (UOM): NOS for numbers (pieces), KG for kilograms.

r8.quote: cell_safety (Lithium cell): 1 if the part contains or charges lithium cells, else 0. Set by Quality.

r9.quote: created_by and created_on: who created the supplier and when. Migrated suppliers show MIGRATION.

r10.quote: Certificates (sup_cert): cert_type (UN38.3, ISO-9001 ...), doc_ref (document reference), valid_to, uploaded_by, uploaded_on.

r11.quote: Rate contracts (sup_rate): itm_cd, rate, valid_from, valid_to.

r12.quote: pr_no (Request number): PR/<year>/<five digits>, for example PR/2026/04417.

r13.quote: po_no (Order number): PO/<year>/<five digits>, for example PO/2026/01182.

r14.quote: fetch_tok: a token returned by the Fetch service (po_fetch) and required by Save (po_save). It is valid once, for one supplier and item.

r15.quote: VAT20-UK: VAT 20%, for a supplier in the same country as the organisation unit (the UK).

r16.quote: N30, N45, N60: net 30, 45 or 60 days from the invoice. ADV: advance payment.

r17.quote: available = amount − committed, returned by the budget check service (bud_check).

conflicts.today: Modern approval limits apply
conflicts.other: In Ledgerline 7.0, approval limits were assigned to roles rather than individual user logins, assessing gross order value including carriage and taxes

conflicts.today: Ledgerline 7.0 order processing rules applied
conflicts.other: In Ledgerline 6 quick guide v6.4 (effective 2009-05-01 under Derek Ramsden), vendor orders were raised in screen PO-ENT, where exiting without saving discarded lines without warning

r3.quote: Version | 6.4 Effective | 2009-05-01 Owner | Derek Ramsden (IT) Status | SUPERSEDED

r4.quote: This manual describes Ledgerline ERP 7.0. It is replaced by MAN-PUR-72.

r5.quote: Fetch is optional. You may type the rate, tax code and payment terms yourself.

r6.quote: Unauthorised orders remain visible in the system but cannot be received at the goods inwards bays.

r7.quote: The tax code's region is not the supplier's state. Change the tax code.

r8.quote: Approval limits are set on each role rather than against individual user logins.

r9.quote: the system assesses the gross total in pounds, so an order that seems within a limit on net lines may still fail approval.

man-pur-72.title: MAN-PUR-72 Ledgerline ERP 7.2 User Manual, Purchasing
man-pur-72.summary: User manual for Ledgerline ERP 7.2 Purchasing, covering system conventions, order processing, release, amendments, and administration settings.

conflicts.today: The configurable direct-order limit setting in Ledgerline is £50,000
conflicts.other: From 2026-12-01, IT will update the direct-order limit setting in Ledgerline to £25,000 on the evening of 2026-11-30 under AMD-PUR-2026-03

r1.loc_text: p. 1, §3. What purchase staff must do
r1.quote: The senior buyer runs the certificate-expiry report (MAN-PUR-72 §22.6) on the first working day of each month with 90 days as the window, and writes to every supplier whose UN 38.3 certificate expires inside it.

r2.quote: Version 7.2.3 Effective 2025-01-15 Owner Ledgerline Systems, Documentation Group Status CURRENT

r3.loc_text: p. 2, §1.5 Version history of this manual
r3.quote: Version 7.2.3 (January 2025) added the Fetch requirement on the order screen (§11.3), the cost-centre warning W-CC-114 (§17.6) and the error catalogue

r4.quote: Dates are entered as DD-MM-YYYY on screens and returned as YYYY-MM-DD by services.

r5.quote: After three wrong passwords your user ID is locked for 30 minutes; IT can unlock it sooner.

r6.quote: A session that has been idle for 20 minutes is closed. Unsaved work on open screens is lost.

r7.quote: F2 Open the lookup for the current field F3 Fetch defaults (order and request screens) F5 Refresh the screen from the database

r8.quote: A password must be at least eight characters and include a digit. Passwords expire every 90 days.

r9.quote: A purchase order can be printed only after it is Released; before that the print shows the word DRAFT across the page.

r10.quote: If no contract covers today, it fills the rate of the last order to that supplier for that item, and shows the rate field in yellow.

r11.quote: The status bar shows <PO number> SAVED. The message is the same whatever status the order was saved in.

r12.quote: If the cost centre is closed, the order is saved as DR (Draft) with warning W-CC-114, and nothing is sent to anyone.

r13.quote: If the order is against a request whose approver's limit covers the order's gross value, it is AP and the request's approver is recorded. Otherwise the order is PA

r14.quote: An order against a request may not be for a different item or a larger quantity than the request (ERR-PO-0604). The request is closed (CL)

r15.quote: Orders can be saved only for ACTIVE suppliers. A blocked supplier gives ERR-SUP-0031. Ledgerline does not check certificates on this screen.

r16.quote: Press Reject and enter a reason (mandatory). The status becomes RJ and the budget committed for the order is released.

r17.quote: The status becomes RL, the release date is recorded, the quantity is added to stock on order, and Ledgerline e-mails the order to the supplier's order address.

r18.quote: An order in any other status gives ERR-PO-0715 (DOCUMENT NOT IN RELEASABLE STATUS) with the current status in brackets.

r19.quote: If it is more than the approval covers, the order goes back to PA for approval, even if it had been released.

r20.quote: The status becomes CN, committed budget is released, and for a released order the quantity is removed from stock on order. Tell the supplier yourself; Ledgerline does not send a cancellation notice.

r21.quote: Orders in status CN, RJ or CL cannot be amended (ERR-PO-0801).

r22.section: 16.2 Which status means the supplier has the order
r22.loc_text: p. 10, §16.2 Which status means the supplier has the order
r22.quote: Only RL. An order in DR, PA or AP has not been sent to the supplier.

r23.quote: It does not e-mail anyone when an order is saved as Draft.

r24.quote: Wrong user ID or password. After three attempts the user ID is locked (§2.1).

r25.quote: The approval limit is stored on the user, not the role, and is set from the company's approval matrix.

r26.quote: Orders migrated from 6.x appear with status RL or CL only. Their rates and tax codes are as they were in 6.x and are not recalculated.

r27.quote: IT will change the direct-order limit in Ledgerline from £50,000 to £25,000 on the evening of 30 November 2026 (MAN-PUR-72 §23.4).

pol-abc-011.title: POL-ABC-011 Anti-Bribery and Gifts Policy
pol-abc-011.summary: Anti-bribery and gifts policy setting declaration rules, a £50 gift threshold, tender gift bans, and a £150 plant head hospitality approval limit.

r1.quote: POL-ABC-011 Version 1.3 Effective 2024-01-01 Owner Finance Approved by Henrik Weber (plant head) Status CURRENT Classification INTERNAL

r2.quote: Northbridge Cycles does not offer or accept inducements to influence commercial decisions, secure contracts, or gain improper advantage with suppliers, bike shops, or public bodies.

r3.quote: All gifts or offers of hospitality must be declared through line management before acceptance, or immediately following receipt where advance notice was impossible.

r4.quote: Payments to third parties must follow established finance controls, supported by proper invoices and standard purchase orders.

r5.quote: Never accept cash, gift vouchers, or loans under any circumstances.

r6.quote: Decline any offer made during active tender processes or price negotiations, regardless of value.

r7.quote: Any gift worth more than £50 from a supplier or customer is declared in the gifts register within five working days.

r8.quote: However, once an item crosses the threshold stated in clause 2.1, it must be recorded in the register held by the company secretary.

r9.quote: Purchase staff must not accept any gift, however small, from a supplier taking part in an open quotation or tender.

r10.quote: Forgetting that the ban in clause 2.2 applies to all purchase staff, even if the individual is not the lead buyer on that specific tender.

r11.quote: Hospitality worth more than £150 a head needs the plant head's approval in advance.

r12.quote: When working out the cost per head, remember to include travel, admission passes, and related extras.

pol-apr-002.title: POL-APR-002 Approval Matrix for Purchasing
pol-apr-002.summary: Purchasing approval matrix establishing gross document authorization tiers up to £5,000,000, self-approval prohibitions, and service account restrictions.

conflicts.today: Approval limits are calculated on gross value including VAT
conflicts.other: Limits were calculated strictly on net value before VAT

conflicts.today: Financial authorization limits are £250,000 (PUR-EXEC), £500,000 (PUR-SR), £1,000,000 (PUR-MGR), and £5,000,000 (PLANT-HEAD) gross
conflicts.other: Financial limits were £200,000 (PUR-EXEC), £400,000 (PUR-SR), £750,000 (PUR-MGR), and £5,000,000 (PLANT-HEAD) gross

r1.loc_text: sheet Matrix, row PUR-EXEC, SHEET Matrix
r1.quote: role_cd=PUR-EXEC | limit_gbp_gross=250000

r2.quote: appr_limit REAL Approval limit, gross incl. VAT

r3.quote: Document POL-APR-002 Version 3.0 Effective 2026-04-01 Owner Plant head's office, Northbridge Cycles Approved by Henrik Weber (plant head)

r4.quote: This matrix sets who may approve a purchase request or purchase order, and up to what value. It is the matrix referred to in Purchase Policy §5.2.

r5.quote: Every limit is a limit on the gross value including VAT of one document. Freight and packing charged on the order count towards the gross value.

r6.quote: A limit is per document, not per day or per supplier.

r7.quote: Splitting one requirement into several orders to stay inside a limit is not allowed. Orders for the same item from the same supplier raised within seven days of each other are treated as one requirement.

r8.quote: PUR-EXEC Purchase executive £250,000 PUR-SR Senior buyer £500,000 PUR-MGR Purchase manager £1,000,000 PLANT-HEAD Plant head £5,000,000 STORES Stores no approval authority

r9.quote: A document within the raiser's own limit is approved when it is submitted. Ledgerline records the raiser as the approver.

r10.quote: A document above the raiser's limit goes to the raiser's manager. If the manager's limit does not cover it, it goes on up the line to the first person whose limit does.

r11.quote: Above £5,000,000 the order needs the Managing Director's written approval outside Ledgerline. Ledgerline shows ERR-APR-0009 (no approver found) for such a document; the plant head's office then records the MD's approval.

r12.quote: Nobody may approve a document they raised (Purchase Policy §5.3). Ledgerline refuses with ERR-APR-0003.

r13.quote: Integration and service accounts (role SYS-ADMIN, for example SVC_AGENT) have no approval authority under this matrix, whatever their technical permissions in Ledgerline. A document approved by a service account is treated as unapproved and must be cancelled or re-approved by a person.

r14.quote: An approver on leave may delegate in writing to someone of the same or a higher role for a stated period. Delegation to a lower role is not allowed.

r15.quote: The plant head reviews this matrix every April, and when the organisation changes.

r16.loc_text: p. 3, §5. Procedure: notes and common mistakes
r16.quote: The limit must correspond strictly to the entry found in the approval matrix (POL-APR-002) for that specific job title.

r17.quote: A service account never approves documents (POL-APR-002 §4.2).

r18.quote: All purchase orders, stock requisitions, and capital commitments raised across the Manchester factory and the Leeds unit must comply with the company authorisation tiers.

r19.quote: Value added tax must not be included when determining which band of authority an order falls under, but the tax portion must still be entered correctly for accounting purposes.

r26.quote: Limits apply to the gross value including VAT, not the basic value. The approval matrix (POL-APR-002) sets each role's limit.

r27.quote: An order above the raiser's own limit must be approved by the next person up the line whose limit covers it. Nobody may approve an order they raised.

r5.quote: Version 2.3 Effective 2026-04-01 Owner Purchase department, Northbridge Cycles Approved by Daniel Okafor (purchase manager) Status CURRENT Classification INTERNAL

r6.quote: This policy says how a supplier enters the supplier master in Ledgerline, what papers it must give us, when it is blocked, and how we stop the same supplier being registered twice. It sits under the Purchase Policy (POL-PUR-001 §6).

r7.quote: It covers every supplier of materials, components, packing and services to the Manchester plant (NBC-MAN-01) and the Leeds unit (NBC-LDS-01).

r8.quote: It does not cover one-time cash purchases under £5,000 made from the petty-cash imprest; those follow the Finance petty-cash note.

r9.quote: A new supplier is proposed by a purchase executive or senior buyer, with at least one written quotation and the reason an existing supplier cannot meet the need.

r10.quote: Before the supplier is created in Ledgerline (screen PUR-SUP-01), the proposer must collect: the VAT registration certificate (VAT number), the company registration number, a bank letter confirming the account, proof of insurance, and the signed Supplier Code of Conduct.

r11.quote: The proposer must search the supplier master first (screen PUR-SUP-03) by name, by city and by VAT number, and attach the search result to the onboarding file.

r12.quote: The purchase manager approves the onboarding file. Only after that approval may the supplier be created in Ledgerline.

r13.quote: A supplier created in Ledgerline is ACTIVE from the day it is created, but no order may be placed with it until every document in §3.2 and, for lithium-cell parts, the certificate in §4 is on file.

r14.quote: Onboarding normally takes five working days from a complete file. Urgency is not a reason to skip any step in this section.

r15.quote: A supplier of any lithium-cell part (battery packs, hub motors, chargers, and any item marked lithium-cell in the item master) must hold a UN 38.3 certificate. This is the certificate referred to in Purchase Policy §6.2.

r16.quote: The certificate must be a test report from a laboratory accredited for lithium-cell materials (for example a laboratory accredited to ISO/IEC 17025 for UN 38.3 testing).

r17.quote: The certificate is uploaded in Ledgerline against the supplier (certificate type UN38.3) with its document reference and its valid-to date, and checked by the senior buyer before the first order.

r18.quote: A UN 38.3 certificate is accepted if it was issued within the last 24 months and its valid-to date has not passed.

r19.quote: An expired certificate counts as no certificate. The supplier stays ACTIVE in the master, but no lithium-cell part may be ordered from it until a new certificate is uploaded and checked.

r20.quote: The certificate covers the supplier, not a single item. If the supplier changes the cells or the design of a part (for example a new cell maker or cell chemistry), it must give a fresh test report for that part.

r21.quote: Ledgerline does not stop an order to a supplier without a certificate. The check in this section is done by the person raising the order, and by the approver.

r22.quote: A supplier is BLOCKED in the master when: it has been replaced by a new code (for example after a merger or a change of VAT number); it has failed two quality audits in a row; or Finance has asked for a block for unpaid debit notes.

r23.quote: A blocked supplier keeps its code and history, but Ledgerline refuses new orders to it with ERR-SUP-0031.

r24.quote: Only the purchase manager may ask IT to unblock a supplier, in writing, with the reason.

r25.quote: When a supplier is given a new code, the old code is blocked and renamed "(old code, do not use)". Voltway Cells' old code VC-EIN-0009 is an example.

r26.quote: One legal supplier has exactly one active code. The VAT number is the test of sameness: two records with the same VAT number are the same supplier.

r27.quote: A name that is close to an existing supplier in the same city must be treated as that supplier until shown otherwise.

r28.quote: A near-match in a different city or with a different VAT number is a different supplier (for example Voltway Paints & Coatings, Rotterdam, is not Voltway Cells, Eindhoven).

r29.quote: Ledgerline refuses to create a second supplier with a VAT number that is already registered (ERR-SUP-0118). It does not catch a duplicate entered without a VAT number; that check is the proposer's job under §3.3.

r30.quote: A duplicate created by mistake must be reported to the purchase manager the same day, blocked, and its open documents moved to the correct code.

r31.quote: Each regular supplier of a regular item has a rate contract in Ledgerline with a valid-from and valid-to date.

r32.quote: A new rate contract replaces the old one from its valid-from date. Older rates stay in the history for reference only.

r4.quote: Investigate long-standing unbilled receipts with suppliers and request missing invoices or credit notes where deliveries remain unmatched.

r5.quote: Agree any required accrual adjustments with the accounts department for deliveries received without paperwork before the cut-off.

r6.quote: Close or cancel completed purchase orders where residual balances remain due to short deliveries or minor price variances.

r7.quote: Review orders placed on hold and resolve queries regarding disputed prices, damaged parts, or missing quality certificates.

r8.quote: Ensure that amended order lines have received appropriate internal authorisations prior to the period cut-off.

r9.quote: Verify that delivery schedules for frame fabrications, motors, battery packs, and wiring looms reflect realistic supplier lead times for the following month.

r11.section: Supplier query resolution and ledger reconciliation
r11.loc_text: Supplier query resolution and ledger reconciliation

r12.section: Supplier query resolution and ledger reconciliation
r12.loc_text: Supplier query resolution and ledger reconciliation
r12.quote: Confirm that direct deliveries to bike shops for warranty or fleet replacements have been confirmed and receipted in the system.

r13.section: Supplier query resolution and ledger reconciliation
r13.loc_text: Supplier query resolution and ledger reconciliation
r13.quote: Review the debit balance report to confirm that payments on account or unallocated credit notes are investigated.

r14.quote: Notify the finance office in Manchester that purchasing entries for the period are complete so that the sub-ledger can be frozen.

r15.quote: File all signed supplier delivery notes, completed rejection slips, and order change forms in the departmental archives in line with company procedures.

qrc-01.title: QRC-01 Raising a purchase request
qrc-01.summary: Quick reference guide covering steps, item validation, cost centre rules, and submission on Ledgerline screen PUR-PR-01 for raising purchase requests.

r1.section: Quick reference: Raising a purchase request
r1.loc_text: p. 1, Quick reference: Raising a purchase request
r1.quote: Document QRC-01 Version 2026.1 Effective 2026-01-12 Owner Purchasing key users Status CURRENT Classification INTERNAL

r2.quote: 1. PUR-PR-01: enter the item code, press F3 (Fetch).

r3.quote: 2. Check the cost centre: is it OPEN? 3. Enter quantity and need-by date.

r4.quote: 4. F8 Save (status DR), then F9 Submit.

r5.quote: 5. Within your limit: approved at once. Above it: goes to your manager.

r6.quote: If the item description does not appear after pressing F3 (Fetch), check that the item code has been typed correctly before trying again.

r7.quote: Do not overwrite the description field manually if the lookup fails, as this causes errors when the purchase order is generated.

r8.quote: When ordering non-stock goods, ensure the general ledger category defaults properly once the item code is retrieved.

r9.quote: If a cost centre is marked as closed, the system will prevent submission later in the process. Contact the finance office to have the charge code reopened

r10.quote: Splitting lines across separate cost centres requires each line to be confirmed individually.

r11.quote: Enter the quantity in the standard pack units shown on screen rather than loose singles.

r12.quote: Ensure the need-by date allows for supplier lead periods, particularly for parts coming into the Manchester works or the Leeds unit.

r13.quote: Avoid setting need-by dates to the current day, as the purchasing team batch their releases during the working week.

r14.quote: Pressing F9 sends the request forward; check the status prompt at the foot of the screen to confirm the action took effect.

r15.quote: Any request that sits above your limit routes automatically to your manager. If urgent, inform your manager by internal e-mail so they can clear their approval queue.

qrc-05.title: QRC-05 Uploading a supplier certificate
qrc-05.summary: Quick reference guide for uploading and committing UN 38.3 supplier compliance certificates in Ledgerline and recording sign-off on NBC-F-113.

r1.section: Quick reference: Uploading a supplier certificate
r1.loc_text: p. 1, Quick reference: Uploading a supplier certificate
r1.quote: Document QRC-05 Version 2026.1 Effective 2026-01-12 Owner Purchasing key users Status CURRENT

r2.quote: 1. Supplier master, Certificates tab, Add. 2. Type UN38.3, document reference, valid to. 3. Attach the scanned test report. 4. F8: CERT SAVED. 5. Ask the senior buyer to check it and initial NBC-F-113.

r3.quote: Save the scanned document in the shared purchasing archive using the standard naming convention so other buyers can locate the original if required. Check that the test report relates specifically to the battery cell or pack supplied to the Manchester plant or the Leeds unit.

r4.quote: Key the certificate type exactly as UN38.3 to ensure automated purchase order validation functions correctly.

r5.quote: Enter the document reference precisely as printed on the supplier report, including any prefix or suffix. Verify the valid to date against the expiry stated on the report, or use the agreed default review period if no explicit expiry appears.

r6.quote: Press F8 to commit the record and ensure the status bar displays CERT SAVED before closing the screen. If the system does not show CERT SAVED, do not re-key the line; check the network connection and try F8 once more.

r7.quote: Do not attach duplicate files for the same part; update the existing certificate line if an amended report has been received.

r8.quote: Confirm the senior buyer has initialled NBC-F-113 before releasing any pending purchase orders for delivery. File the initialled NBC-F-113 in the purchasing office compliance binder.

qrc-07.title: QRC-07 Quick reference: Lithium battery labels
qrc-07.summary: Quick reference guide for selecting, applying, and booking UN lithium battery labels on outgoing parcels to prevent delivery rejections and despatch errors.

r1.loc_text: p. 1, Quick reference: Lithium battery labels
r1.quote: Document QRC-07 Version 2026.1 Effective 2026-01-12 Owner Purchasing key users Status CURRENT Classification INTERNAL

r2.quote: Every parcel with a pack requires the PKG-LBL-UN label.

r3.quote: Use designation UN3480 when the lithium battery pack travels alone as a replacement part.

r4.quote: Use designation UN3481 when the pack is installed inside the frame or boxed together with the bicycle. Never apply both markings to the same carton.

r5.quote: Keep a supply of label rolls beside the packing benches in the Manchester packing area and the Leeds unit. Store rolls in their original cartons away from direct heat and moisture

r6.quote: Apply the label flat to the outer carton on the same face as the carrier address label. Do not place the label over seams, carton closures, strapping, or tape.

r7.quote: Ensure the parcel is marked for carrier service DGX during collection booking. Carrier drivers will reject consignments if the service code on the manifest does not match the hazardous markings

r8.loc_text: p. 1, Despatch sequence in the system
r8.quote: Always print the label before posting the despatch transaction. If this error appears, contact the system supervisor to clear the transaction flag before reprinting.

rn-7-1.title: RN-7.1 Ledgerline ERP 7.1 Release Notes

r1.quote: Ledgerline ERP 7.1 was released on 8 May 2017. It is a release for all Ledgerline 7 customers.

r3.quote: If the intended substitute occupies a post with lower standing, the interface rejects the entry and displays the validation prompt indicating that the delegate must hold the same or a higher role, accompanied by error reference ERR-DLG-0210.

r4.quote: Existing delegations remain active, but any revision, reinstatement, or fresh entry will encounter this restriction immediately.

r5.quote: If the external interface attempts to pass an invalid pairing, the routine must catch the rejection, halt the batch transfer without corrupting adjacent records, and write an entry into the local interface log rather than allowing unattended transactions to fail silently.

r6.quote: On screen, the stock maintenance and warehouse enquiry displays now provide an explicit ownership indicator alongside standard location entries. Users recording receipts can allocate incoming parts directly to a consignment category, preventing these items from being absorbed into general company valuation while keeping them visible for production scheduling.

r7.quote: Key users should practice booking incoming components under consignment terms, verifying that the on-hand quantities increment correctly without generating an unvouched liability in the purchase ledger.

r8.quote: Under the revised service routines, the approval of an engineering change note prompts an immediate revision check against every active assembly run. The main entry screen now displays a revised status flag beside the drawing reference, and the component allocation window locks further issues of the superseded item.

r9.quote: The staging tables now require the active engineering change note reference to be supplied alongside the part issue message. Any automated routine that posts completed sub-assemblies back into stock must interrogate this reference; if the external system passes an obsolete component against a revised works order, the interface service will reject the batch file

r10.quote: Users printing the summary report to network dot-matrix printers may observe misaligned column headers on wider continuous stationery.

r11.quote: Users are advised to enter at least the first letter of the customer surname or the initial character of the trading name prior to executing the search.

r12.quote: In busy periods with concurrent entries across the Leeds unit and the Manchester plant, the free stock display on the inventory inquiry screen may occasionally lag behind recent receipts until the screen is manually closed and reopened.

screen-ap-cur-13.title: AP-CUR-13 Currency Rate
screen-ap-cur-13.summary: Ledgerline screen for retrieving, listing, and maintaining foreign currency conversion rates to GBP.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Move the cursor to the RATE DT field and enter the calendar date for which the conversion factor applies. Press the cur_get button to execute the CURRENCY RATE GET service. Ledgerline ERP 7.2 queries the central rate table held on the server. If a record matches the entered parameters, the system populates the RATE TO GBP field

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: If you wish to review a sequence of recorded entries across a broader range, press the cur_list button to invoke the CURRENCY RATE LIST service. The terminal displays a browse window listing historical currency entries associated with the selected foreign currency code, arranged in reverse chronological sequence.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: Obtain the authorised exchange sheet issued by the finance office. The finance team provides the official conversion values agreed with the bank for the operational period. Never use unauthorized public feeds or approximate values taken from consumer finance notices.

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: Enter the relevant foreign currency identifier into the CUR CD field.

r2.file: 02_procedures/SOP-FIN-001 Cost Centre Open and Close v1.1.pdf

r3.section: What to check on the screen
r3.loc_text: p. 4, What to check on the screen
r3.quote: On screen FIN-CC-01, check that the status indicator reflects the intended state of the record before saving changes.

r4.file: 02_procedures/SOP-FIN-001 Cost Centre Open and Close v1.1.pdf
r4.section: What to check on the screen
r4.loc_text: p. 4, What to check on the screen
r4.quote: Review the open balance and commitments tabs on the screen to confirm that all ledger balances stand at zero and that no unposted journals remain pending against the code.

r5.file: 02_procedures/SOP-FIN-001 Cost Centre Open and Close v1.1.pdf
r5.section: What to check on the screen
r5.loc_text: p. 4, What to check on the screen
r5.quote: Inspect the error message panel if an attempt to save fails. An alert showing ERR-CC-0310 indicates that outstanding paperwork remains attached

r6.quote: Check the cost centre on FIN-CC-01 before saving. Your default cost centre may have been closed by Finance; Ledgerline does not warn you on the request.

r7.quote: The cost centre screen shows each cost centre's name, owner, status (OPEN or CLOSED) and the date it was closed, with its budget for the quarter and the amount already committed.

r8.quote: Ledgerline does not refuse a document charged to a closed cost centre: it saves the document as Draft and sets warning W-CC-114 (see §17.6).

r9.quote: Defaults are not updated automatically when Finance closes a cost centre, so a default can point to a closed one. Always check the cost centre before saving.

r10.quote: If the gross value is more than the budget available, Save fails with ERR-BUD-0207.

conflicts.today: F3 Fetch must be executed after entering or changing supplier and item, or saving fails with ERR-SCR-0221
conflicts.other: In 2016 training materials, Fetch was described as optional with rates typed manually

conflicts.other: In planned Ledgerline ERP 7.3 (effective March 2027), multi-line purchase orders will be supported on PUR-PO-01

conflicts.other: In planned Ledgerline ERP 7.3 (effective March 2027), an invalid UN 38.3 certificate on any line blocks saving with ERR-SUP-0207

r1.quote: raise the order on PUR-PO-01 with order type STD and the request number in Source PR.

r2.quote: Press F3 (Fetch) after entering the supplier and the item. Save is refused with ERR-SCR-0221 if Fetch was not run.

r3.quote: Check the tax code before saving. Fetch always fills VAT20-UK. For a supplier outside the UK change it to VAT20-RC, or Save fails with ERR-PO-0412.

r4.quote: Press F8 and read the Status field, not just the status bar. SAVED appears whatever the status.

r5.quote: DR means the order is stuck (usually a closed cost centre, warning W-CC-114); PA means it waits for approval; AP means it can be released.

r6.quote: STD (standard) orders are raised against an approved purchase request; enter the request number in Source PR. DIR (direct) orders have no request and are allowed only for small values

r7.quote: Ledgerline 7.2.3 refuses to save an order on which Fetch was not run for the current supplier and item, with ERR-SCR-0221 (FETCH NOT DONE).

r8.quote: For a supplier in another country you must change it to the reverse-charge code (-RC) before saving; otherwise Save fails with ERR-PO-0412.

r9.quote: Ledgerline 7.2 allows one line per order on this screen; for several items, raise several orders.

r10.quote: A DIR order is refused on Save if its gross value is above the direct-order limit configured for your company (shipped default £50,000), with ERR-PO-0610. Raise a purchase request instead. A DIR order may not refer to a request (ERR-PO-0611).

r11.quote: Menu: Purchase > Order entry. Roles: PUR-EXEC, PUR-SR, SYS-ADMIN.

r12.quote: Enter the source request, supplier and item, then press Fetch: it brings in the contract rate, tax code, payment terms and the request's cost centre, date and quantity.

services-ap-acr.title: AP acr services
services-ap-acr.summary: Ledgerline AP acr services for executing, retrieving, and reversing goods received not invoiced (GRNI) accrual batches on screen AP-ACR-10.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf

conflicts.today: In technical YAML service definitions and reference manuals, acr_run has mandatory acr_no and optional comment, while acr_reverse has mandatory acr_no and optional reason
conflicts.other: User manual MAN-AP-72 states acr_run generates the ACR NO and requires COMMENT, and acr_reverse validates that REASON is populated

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: Screen AP-ACR-10 scans open purchase receipts across the system, evaluates the unmatched quantities against purchase order values, and posts the necessary accrual journal to the general ledger.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: It also provides the facility to retrieve previously generated accrual batches and reverse them at the start of a subsequent period once invoices begin to clear.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r3.loc_text: p. 34, Generating a new accrual run:
r3.quote: Press the acr_run button to execute the service GRNI ACCRUAL RUN. Ledgerline will lock the screen momentarily while the system scans all unmatched goods received records

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r4.loc_text: p. 34, Retrieving an existing accrual record:
r4.quote: Press the acr_get button to call the service GRNI ACCRUAL GET. Ledgerline interrogates the database and returns the saved run details.

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: Ledgerline validates that the selected ACR NO is currently active and has not already been reversed.

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: ERR-ACR-0001: This message appears when the service GRNI ACCRUAL RUN or GRNI ACCRUAL REVERSE encounters an invalid state or cannot complete the requested action.

r1.loc_text: p. 4, What to check on the screen
r1.quote: navigate to AP-BNK-06 and invoke service bnk_verify. Ensure that all mandatory text fields regarding the call are completed fully.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Screen AP-BNK-06, menu Accounts payable > Supplier bank. Services: bnk_save, bnk_get, bnk_verify, bnk_block, bnk_search.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 validates the field formats, writes the record to the table, and sets field STATUS to show that the record is stored but requires verification.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 checks the user permissions and updates field STATUS to confirm that the bank details are approved for inclusion in automatic payment proposals.

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 writes the stop flag to the account and changes field STATUS to blocked. Once blocked, the account cannot be selected by automated payment generation services.

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: Press bnk_search to invoke the underlying listing service. A search window appears. Locate the relevant supplier and return the selection to the main screen.

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: Screen AP-EXP-09, menu Accounts payable > Expense claim. Services: exp_save, exp_get, exp_search, exp_submit, exp_approve, exp_reject, exp_pay.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Press the button exp_save. Ledgerline calls the background service EXPENSE CLAIM SAVE. The system creates the draft record and populates the field EXP NO with a sequential internal tracking reference.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: leave the specific reference blank and press the button exp_search. Ledgerline calls the service EXPENSE CLAIM LIST to return matching entries in a selection list

services-ap-gl.summary: Ledgerline AP general ledger journal voucher services gl_post, gl_query, and gl_reverse for screen AP-GL-14.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: GL POSTING QUERY (gl_query): Retrieves existing journal voucher records from the ledger based on criteria entered into the header fields.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: GL POSTING POST (gl_post): Validates all entered data across the fields, closes the entry against editing, assigns references, and commits the balances to the nominal ledger.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: The system processes the reversal through the background service, generates a balancing entry in the general ledger, and displays the confirmation.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: The system validates the nominal accounts and checks period controls. If successful, the screen clears and displays the generated reference in the JV NO field.

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: select the gl_reverse (GL POSTING REVERSE) button. Enter the current posting date and the corrective explanation when prompted. The system generates an offsetting voucher and marks the original posting accordingly.

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: enter the voucher reference into the JV NO field, and select the gl_query (GL POSTING QUERY) button. The screen populates the JV DT, COMMENT, and line details.

services-ap-inv.title: AP inv services
services-ap-inv.summary: Ledgerline AP supplier invoice services handling creation, query, posting, hold, release, and cancellation on screen AP-INV-01.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: inv_search (SUPPLIER INVOICE LIST): Opens the query window to find existing vouchers.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: inv_get (SUPPLIER INVOICE GET): Retrieves an existing voucher using the internal document reference or supplier details.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: inv_save (SUPPLIER INVOICE SAVE): Validates entered values, creates or updates the draft voucher, and generates an internal document reference.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: inv_post (SUPPLIER INVOICE POST): Commits the voucher to the purchase ledger and general ledger.

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: inv_hold (SUPPLIER INVOICE HOLD): Places a hold flag on the voucher to prevent payment.

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: inv_release (SUPPLIER INVOICE RELEASE): Clears the hold flag so the invoice can proceed to payment.

services-ap-mat.title: AP mat services
services-ap-mat.summary: Ledgerline accounts payable three-way matching services attaching to screen AP-MAT-02 for invoice verification, retrieval, search, and manager override.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: Alternatively, if the specific reference is not known, leave the field clear and click the mat_search button to invoke the THREE-WAY MATCH LIST service.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: You may enter the reference directly into the AP DOC field and click the mat_get button, which executes the THREE-WAY MATCH GET service.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: Click the mat_run button to call the THREE-WAY MATCH RUN service. Ledgerline compares the quantities received against the quantities invoiced, and the order price against the invoice line price.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: Click the mat_override button to execute the THREE-WAY MATCH OVERRIDE service. The system applies the override, marks the STATUS field as cleared by management

services-ap-pay.title: AP pay services
services-ap-pay.summary: Ledgerline AP payment run services supporting screen AP-PAY-03 for proposing, approving, releasing, generating, and cancelling supplier payment batches.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 calls service PAYMENT RUN PROPOSE. The software evaluates open items, applies discount rules, checks for valid supplier bank mandates

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 invokes service PAYMENT RUN GET to retrieve the proposed transactions into the working grid.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: The system validates that the approving terminal has current sign-off delegation, locks the underlying invoices against duplicate processing, and advances STATUS

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: The system updates STATUS to show the batch is released for file creation. This locks the records against manual intervention

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: The programme formats the batch into standard clearing transmission media, writes the file to the secure local bank interface directory, and updates STATUS

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 calls service PAYMENT RUN LIST. A selection prompt displays, allowing operators to locate runs by date, settlement bank, or run identifier.

r7.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r7.quote: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 invokes service PAYMENT RUN CANCEL. Enter an explanatory remark in REASON. The system releases all invoice holds

r8.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
r8.loc_text: p. 15, ERR-PAY-0001 PAYMENT RUN NOT FOUND
r8.quote: ERR-PAY-0001 PAYMENT RUN NOT FOUND Cause: no document or record with that key exists. Remedy: check the number with the list service or the F2 lookup. Raised by: pay_get, pay_approve, pay_release, pay_file, pay_cancel.

r9.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
r9.section: ERR-PAY-0007 PAYMENT RUN NOT IN DRAFT (<status>)
r9.loc_text: p. 15, ERR-PAY-0007 PAYMENT RUN NOT IN DRAFT (<status>)
r9.quote: ERR-PAY-0007 PAYMENT RUN NOT IN DRAFT (<status>) Cause: the action needs the document in Draft (or pending) and it is in another status, shown in brackets. Remedy: refresh and check the status; someone may have acted on it. Raised by: pay_approve, pay_release.

r10.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
r10.quote: ERR-PAY-0105 DATE IN PAST Cause: the date is before today. Remedy: enter today's date or a later one. Raised by: pay_propose, pay_search.

r11.quote: Propose pay_propose Get F3 pay_get Approve F9 pay_approve Release F9 pay_release File pay_file Cancel Shift+F8 pay_cancel Search F2/Enter pay_search

r12.quote: pay_propose PAYMENT RUN PROPOSE Kind: write. Screen: AP-PAY-03. Since: 7.0. Procedures: sp_pay_propose.

services-ap-per.title: AP per services
services-ap-per.summary: Accounts Payable accounting period services controlling listing, status querying, opening, and closing of financial posting intervals on screen AP-PER-11.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf

conflicts.today: Service per_close verifies unposted documents (ERR-PER-0010) and unrun GRNI accruals (ERR-PER-0011), while per_open raises ERR-PER-0001 or common errors, and per_status checks period existence (ERR-PER-0001).
conflicts.other: Narrative manual worked examples describe per_status raising ERR-PER-0001 for pending batches, per_close raising ERR-PER-0801 for unbalanced transactions or ERR-PER-0010 for already closed periods, and per_open returning ERR-PER-0011 for invalid intervals or ERR-PER-0801 for authorisation failures.

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: Ledgerline calls the underlying service AP PERIOD LIST and retrieves all configured accounting intervals from the system control tables.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r2.loc_text: p. 37, Checking a specific period status
r2.quote: Ledgerline invokes the service AP PERIOD STATUS to query the database records for that single entry.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: Ledgerline calls the service AP PERIOD OPEN to validate the request and update the master control table.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: Ledgerline triggers the service AP PERIOD CLOSE. The system checks all underlying ledger files to confirm that no unposted journals or incomplete invoice allocations remain tied to the specified period.

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: This message is returned when attempting to run per_close against a period that is already closed, or against a future period that was never opened.

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: The user clicks the per_status button to call the AP PERIOD STATUS service. This verifies that no unposted purchase batches remain pending. If unposted transactions remain, the system halts the routine with message ERR-PER-0001

r7.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r7.quote: Once the status check confirms the ledger is clear, the user clicks the per_close button. The AP PERIOD CLOSE service sets the selected interval to closed. If the interval has already been closed by another user, message ERR-PER-0010 appears

r8.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-AP-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Accounts Payable v7.2.3.pdf
r8.quote: The user clicks the per_open button. The AP PERIOD OPEN service updates the record so that buyers and finance staff can begin entering fresh invoices. If the clerk attempts to open an invalid interval, the screen returns message ERR-PER-0011.

r9.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
r9.quote: ERR-PER-0001 AP PERIOD NOT FOUND Cause: no document or record with that key exists. Remedy: check the number with the list service or the F2 lookup. Raised by: per_close, per_open, per_status.

services-inv-adj.title: INV adj services
services-inv-adj.summary: Inventory adjustment service group in Ledgerline ERP for creating, retrieving, approving, posting, and cancelling stock adjustment records on screen INV-ADJ-05.

conflicts.today: In the current v7.2.3 manual and service definitions, services are documented under MAN-INV-72 v7.2.3 and individual YAML specifications.
conflicts.other: The older v7.2.2 manual listed the same six services and validation errors under §4. Stock Adjustment.

r1.section: Creating a New Stock Adjustment Record
r1.loc_text: p. 8, Creating a New Stock Adjustment Record
r1.quote: Click the adj_save button to run the STOCK ADJUSTMENT SAVE service. Ledgerline performs validation checks across the line data. If no errors are detected, the system writes the record, populates the ADJ NO field

r2.quote: enter the known reference into the ADJ NO field and click the adj_get button to run the STOCK ADJUSTMENT GET service.

r3.quote: click the adj_search button to run the STOCK ADJUSTMENT LIST service. Enter search criteria such as warehouse or date ranges

r4.quote: Click the adj_approve button to execute the STOCK ADJUSTMENT APPROVE service. Ledgerline checks the line value thresholds against the operator profile.

r5.section: Posting an Adjustment to the Ledger
r5.loc_text: p. 8, Posting an Adjustment to the Ledger
r5.quote: Click the adj_post button to trigger the STOCK ADJUSTMENT POST service. Ledgerline locks the document against further data entry, updates the perpetual inventory balance

r6.quote: Click the adj_cancel button to run the STOCK ADJUSTMENT CANCEL service. Ledgerline sets the STATUS field to show the document is void.

services-inv-ccp.title: INV ccp services
services-inv-ccp.summary: Ledgerline inventory cycle count plan services providing creation, retrieval, listing, and order generation via screen INV-CCP-14.

conflicts.today: Under Ledgerline 7.2.3, ccp_save automatically assigns the CCP NO and sets status to active, while ccp_generate creates count orders evaluating inventory history
conflicts.other: Under superseded v7.2.2, ccp_generate generated the CCP NO and set status to draft, while ccp_save confirmed the plan

r1.section: Creating a new cycle count plan
r1.loc_text: p. 54, Creating a new cycle count plan
r1.quote: Press the button ccp_save to invoke the underlying service CYCLE COUNT PLAN SAVE. • Ledgerline processes the record, validates the warehouse location and inventory classification

r2.section: Retrieving an existing cycle count plan
r2.loc_text: p. 54, Retrieving an existing cycle count plan
r2.quote: press the button ccp_search to invoke the service CYCLE COUNT PLAN LIST. • Ledgerline returns matching records.

r3.quote: Press the button ccp_generate to call the service CYCLE COUNT PLAN GENERATE. Ledgerline executes the generation service.

r4.quote: Click the ccp_save button to call the service CYCLE COUNT PLAN SAVE. The system validates the entered parameters, assigns a unique reference, and populates the CCP NO field automatically.

r5.quote: enter the reference into the CCP NO field and click the ccp_get button to call CYCLE COUNT PLAN GET.

r6.quote: Alternatively, click the ccp_search button to invoke CYCLE COUNT PLAN LIST and select the plan from the search results.

services-inv-cnt.title: INV cnt services
services-inv-cnt.summary: Ledgerline inventory count services supporting stock count creation, freeze, entry, search, posting, and cancellation on screen INV-CNT-06.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf

conflicts.today: Ledgerline 7.2.3 defines the current INV cnt service group and error behaviours on screen INV-CNT-06
conflicts.other: Superseded manual MAN-INV-72 v7.2.2 (2024-06-10) describes the earlier baseline for the same service group and error list

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: ERR-CNT-0230 OPEN TRANSACTIONS IN COUNT AREA Cause: the rule 'open transactions in count area' failed. Remedy: correct the value shown and try again; if the message persists, quote the code to the key user. Raised by: cnt_freeze.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: ERR-CNT-0240 VARIANCE ABOVE TOLERANCE, RECOUNT REQUIRED Cause: the rule 'variance above tolerance, recount required' failed. Remedy: correct the value shown and try again; if the message persists, quote the code to the key user.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: ERR-CNT-0201 QTY MUST BE > 0 Cause: quantity is zero or negative. Remedy: enter the quantity in the item's unit of measure. Raised by: cnt_entry.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: ERR-CNT-0105 DATE IN PAST Cause: the date is before today. Remedy: enter today's date or a later one. Raised by: cnt_save.

r5.loc_text: p. 12, Initiating a new count header:
r5.quote: Press the cnt_save button to invoke the STOCK COUNT SAVE service. The system generates a unique count reference in the CNT NO field and initialises the STATUS field.

r6.quote: Press the cnt_freeze button to execute the STOCK COUNT FREEZE service. Ledgerline places a temporary movement lock on all bin records falling within the specified boundaries.

r7.quote: Press the cnt_entry button to invoke the STOCK COUNT ENTRY service and open the line entry sub-form.

r8.quote: press the cnt_get button to execute the STOCK COUNT GET service, or press the cnt_search button to call the STOCK COUNT LIST service to browse open counts.

r9.loc_text: p. 12, Posting or cancelling the count:
r9.quote: Press the cnt_post button to call the STOCK COUNT POST service. Ledgerline evaluates the line items, releases the bin freeze, writes inventory adjustment entries to update the stock balances, and marks the STATUS field as closed.

r10.loc_text: p. 12, Posting or cancelling the count:
r10.quote: press the cnt_cancel button to call the STOCK COUNT CANCEL service. Ledgerline clears the count sheets, releases the movement lock on the bins, and updates the STATUS field to cancelled.

r11.quote: If the record cannot be cancelled due to linked transactions, the screen displays ERR-CNT-0801.

r12.quote: It will also halt with ERR-CNT-0240 if an unresolved discrepancy requires supervisor sign-off under warehouse procedures.

services-inv-csg.title: INV csg services
services-inv-csg.summary: Ledgerline inventory services for registering, retrieving, querying, and settling vendor consignment stock records on screen INV-CSG-17.

conflicts.today: Under current v7.2.3, service csg_save registers parcels, allocates CSG NO, and sets status to active; csg_settle transfers liability directly to purchase ledger accruals without duplicate manual goods received notes
conflicts.other: In superseded manual v7.2.2, csg_save creates CSG NO and records stock held on site, while csg_settle transfers liability and ownership

r1.section: To record newly delivered consignment stock:
r1.loc_text: p. 65, To record newly delivered consignment stock:
r1.quote: Press the csg_save (CONSIGNMENT STOCK SAVE) button. Ledgerline executes the save service, allocates the next serial consignment number, and fills the CSG NO field.

r2.section: To retrieve an existing consignment record:

conflicts.today: Services itm_save, itm_update, and itm_uom_conv operate under Ledgerline 7.2.3 and service definitions specifying current fields and error handling.
conflicts.other: In superseded manual v7.2.2 (2024-06-10), itm_save validates keys and commits new stock records, while itm_update modifies descriptions and reorder levels and itm_uom_conv commits alternative unit conversion multipliers.

conflicts.today: The itm_update service definition and technical manual MAN-SVC-72 accept uom_cd as an optional request parameter.
conflicts.other: The user manual MAN-INV-72 states that itm_update modifies description, category, lithium cell indicator, or reorder level without allowing changes to primary UOM.

conflicts.today: The user manual MAN-INV-72 worked example states that service itm_block requires an explanation in the REASON field or raises ERR-ITM-0801.
conflicts.other: The service definition and technical reference MAN-SVC-72 define reason as an optional field and list only ERR-ITM-0001 and ERR-ITM-0011 as specific errors for itm_block.

r1.quote: ERR-ITM-0001 ITEM MASTER NOT FOUND Cause: no document or record with that key exists. Remedy: check the number with the list service or Raised by: itm_update, itm_block, itm_uom_conv.

r2.section: Creating a new item master record
r2.loc_text: p. 41, Creating a new item master record
r2.quote: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 calls the background service ITEM MASTER SAVE. The system verifies the entry against existing database tables.

r3.loc_text: p. 42, Updating an existing item record
r3.quote: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 invokes the service ITEM MASTER UPDATE. Ledgerline checks that the part reference remains valid and that no conflicting database locks exist.

r4.section: Blocking an item from operational use
r4.loc_text: p. 42, Blocking an item from operational use
r4.quote: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 executes the service ITEM MASTER BLOCK. The system checks that the item is active and that a valid entry has been made in the text field explaining the change of status.

r5.loc_text: p. 42, Maintaining unit of measure conversions
r5.quote: The system runs the background routine ITEM MASTER UOM CONV. Ledgerline writes the conversion parameters to the secondary inventory conversion table for that item.

r6.quote: Enter an explanation in the REASON field. If this field is left blank, the service aborts and displays ERR-ITM-0801.

r7.quote: If the specified conversion ratio conflicts with the primary inventory unit, the screen displays ERR-ITM-0011.

services-inv-lot.title: INV lot services
services-inv-lot.summary: Ledgerline Inventory module services for creating, querying, tracing, holding, and releasing item lot and serial records on screen INV-LOT-10.

conflicts.today: Under current v7.2.3, lot_hold updates lot STATUS to held and prevents picking, taking mandatory lot_no and optional reason.
conflicts.other: In superseded v7.2.2, lot_hold updated STATUS to quarantine and captured notes in both REASON and COMMENT.

infobox.Operations: lot_save, lot_get, lot_search, lot_trace, lot_hold, lot_release

r1.quote: Press lot_get. Ledgerline retrieves the existing data from the database and populates the remaining fields.

r2.quote: enter ITEM CD and press lot_search. Ledgerline opens the list window displaying all recorded lots and serial numbers associated with that item.

r3.loc_text: p. 27, Registering or amending lot information:
r3.quote: Press lot_save. Ledgerline validates the entries against the item master and vendor ledgers.

r4.quote: Ledgerline executes the trace routine, displaying the complete genealogy. This shows the arrival on the original GRN NO, movements between store locations

r5.loc_text: p. 27, Placing a lot on hold:
r5.quote: Press lot_hold. Ledgerline updates STATUS to reflect the held condition and immediately restricts the lot from being picked for works orders or sales orders.

r6.loc_text: p. 27, Releasing a lot from quarantine:
r6.quote: Press lot_release. Ledgerline clears the quarantine restriction and returns STATUS to the active, available state.

services-inv-mrn.title: INV mrn services
services-inv-mrn.summary: Ledgerline inventory services for creating, retrieving, searching, posting, and cancelling material issue records on screen INV-MRN-08.

conflicts.today: Services mrn_save and mrn_post validate work orders, issue sequentially, and adjust WIP alongside inventory under v7.2.3
conflicts.other: Older documentation omitted work order validation and explicit WIP balance debiting

r1.quote: Ledgerline validates the fields, creates the draft record, populates the MRN NO field with the next sequential identifier, and sets the STATUS field to draft.

r2.quote: To commit the transaction to the ledger, click the button marked mrn_post (MATERIAL ISSUE POST). Ledgerline updates the perpetual inventory records, reduces the available balance in the warehouse

r3.quote: To abandon an unposted draft that is no longer required, retrieve the record and click the button marked mrn_cancel (MATERIAL ISSUE CANCEL). Ledgerline updates the STATUS field to cancelled

r4.quote: ERR-MRN-0001: The system produces this message when the MRN NO entered for retrieval via mrn_get (MATERIAL ISSUE GET) does not exist in the database.

r5.quote: leave the fields clear or enter a known search parameter such as the works order reference, and click the button marked mrn_search (MATERIAL ISSUE LIST).

r6.quote: mrn_save MATERIAL ISSUE SAVE Kind: write. Screen: INV-MRN-08. Since: 7.0. Procedures: sp_mrn_save.

r7.quote: mrn_get MATERIAL ISSUE GET Kind: read. Screen: INV-MRN-08. Since: 7.0. Procedures: none.

r8.quote: mrn_search MATERIAL ISSUE LIST Kind: read. Screen: INV-MRN-08. Since: 7.0. Procedures: none.

services-inv-pkg.title: INV pkg services
services-inv-pkg.summary: Ledgerline INV services pkg_save, pkg_post, pkg_get, and pkg_search for managing returnable packaging entries and balance updates on screen INV-PKG-15.

conflicts.today: Under current Ledgerline 7.2.3, pkg_save establishes an intact unposted transaction and pkg_post commits to inventory balance files setting status to confirmed.
conflicts.other: In superseded v7.2.2, pkg_save assigned status open and pkg_post set status to posted.

r1.quote: Press the pkg_save button to invoke the RETURNABLE PACKAGING SAVE service. Ledgerline ERP 7.2 validates the input data against the system master tables and places the entry into a saved, unposted state.

r2.quote: Press the pkg_post button to invoke the RETURNABLE PACKAGING POST service. Ledgerline ERP 7.2 will apply the transaction directly to the inventory balance files

r3.quote: enter the exact identifier in the PKG NO field alongside the SUP CD and press the pkg_get button to execute the RETURNABLE PACKAGING GET service.

r4.quote: Press the pkg_search button to execute the RETURNABLE PACKAGING LIST service. Ledgerline ERP 7.2 will populate the working grid with matching container lines

r5.quote: Click pkg_save (RETURNABLE PACKAGING SAVE) to retain the draft record. If the combination of crate reference and supplier is already open on the system, Ledgerline returns ERR-PKG-0007

r6.quote: Once all lines are verified, click pkg_post (RETURNABLE PACKAGING POST). Ledgerline commits the crates to the balance of supplier-owned equipment held on site and updates STATUS to confirmed.

r7.quote: leave PKG NO empty, and select pkg_search (RETURNABLE PACKAGING LIST). The system brings up a grid of existing sessions.

r8.quote: Double-click the relevant row to load the figures back into the main view, then use pkg_get to refresh the latest line entries.

services-inv-qch.title: INV qch services
services-inv-qch.summary: Inventory module services for quality hold processing on screen INV-QCH-11, including save, get, search, release, and reject operations.

conflicts.today: Under v7.2.3, qch_save sets STATUS to hold, qch_release marks stock cleared, and qch_reject prevents release to production; mandatory reason is required for qch_reject
conflicts.other: Under superseded v7.2.2, qch_save set STATUS to detained, qch_release returned quarantined stock, and qch_reject marked items for return to vendor

conflicts.today: qch_save requires reason according to MAN-SVC-72, whereas qch_save.yaml defines reason as optional
conflicts.other: qch_save requires reason in manual vs optional reason in service definition

r1.quote: Press the qch_save button. This calls the QUALITY HOLD SAVE service. Ledgerline ERP 7.2 validates the receipt, confirms that the item code matches the goods receipt line, checks that sufficient stock remains on hand

r2.quote: Press the qch_get button. This calls the QUALITY HOLD GET service. Ledgerline fills all remaining fields, including GRN NO, ITEM CD, QTY, REASON, STATUS, and any previously recorded text in COMMENT.

r3.quote: Press the qch_search button. This invokes the QUALITY HOLD LIST service. Ledgerline presents a list of matching records.

r4.quote: Press the qch_release button. This calls the QUALITY HOLD RELEASE service. Ledgerline ERP 7.2 checks the current status, removes the hold flag from the inventory ledger, transfers the parts to free stock

r5.quote: Press the qch_reject button. This calls the QUALITY HOLD REJECT service. Ledgerline ERP 7.2 updates the inventory ledger to mark the items as rejected stock

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: The system fills the COMPONENT, QTY PER, SCRAP %, and STATUS fields for each line.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Ledgerline calls the bill of materials save service, validates the structure, and commits the records to the database.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: Ledgerline duplicates the full component structure of the source parent into the current work area, filling the COMPONENT, QTY PER, SCRAP %, and STATUS fields.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: Ledgerline displays the indented multi-level explosion, detailing all subordinate sub-assemblies and their constituent parts down to the lowest purchase item level.

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: Ledgerline presents a list of all parent assemblies wherein the selected item appears, together with the parent STATUS and the effective QTY PER.

services-prd-btt.title: PRD btt services
services-prd-btt.summary: Ledgerline PRD battery end-of-line test services managing pack test records, queries, electrical measurement validation, and archive searches on screen QA-BTT-03.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: ERR-BTT-0001 BATTERY END-OF-LINE TEST NOT FOUND Cause: no document or record with that key exists. Remedy: check the number with the list service or the F2 lookup. Raised by: btt_get.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: ERR-BTT-0110 SERIAL ALREADY TESTED Cause: the rule 'serial already tested' failed. Remedy: correct the value shown and try again; if the message persists, quote the code to the key user. Raised by: btt_save. ERR-BTT-0120 OCV OUT OF RANGE Cause: the rule 'ocv out of range' failed. Remedy: correct the value shown and try again; if the message persists, quote the code to the key user. Raised by: btt_save.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: Screen QA-BTT-03, menu Production > Battery end-of-line. Services: btt_save, btt_get, btt_search.

r5.quote: Press btt_search to invoke BATTERY END-OF-LINE TEST LIST. This produces a list of recent records filtered by date and production line

services-prd-cal.title: PRD cal services
services-prd-cal.summary: Production calibration services cal_get, cal_save, and cal_due supporting gauge calibration entry on screen QA-CAL-04.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: Click the cal_get button or select the CALIBRATION GET action from the screen menu. Ledgerline ERP queries the live quality database.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: Press the cal_save button to call the CALIBRATION SAVE service. Ledgerline ERP validates the entries, posts the new dates to the central quality tables

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: Click the cal_due button to call the CALIBRATION DUE service. Ledgerline ERP scans the register for all instruments assigned to active assembly lines where the scheduled renewal date is approaching or already passed.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: Ledgerline retrieves the current registration details for that instrument, displaying the existing tool description and the previous inspection record.

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: The service cal_due is used before commencing a maintenance run to identify all measuring equipment due for testing across the plant

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

services-prd-ecn.title: PRD ecn services
services-prd-ecn.summary: Ledgerline production module services for managing, approving, and releasing engineering change notices on screen PRD-ECN-06.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

conflicts.today: In service definitions, ecn_save raises ERR-ECN-0105 and ecn_release raises ERR-ECN-0105, ERR-ECN-0001, ERR-ECN-0007, and ERR-ECN-0220
conflicts.other: MAN-PRD-72 reports ecn_save raising ERR-ECN-0001 and ERR-ECN-0007, and ecn_approve raising ERR-APR-0003 and ERR-APR-0004

r1.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
r1.quote: ERR-ECN-0105 DATE IN PAST Cause: the date is before today. Remedy: enter today's date or a later one. Raised by: ecn_save, ecn_search.

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: ecn_save (ENGINEERING CHANGE SAVE): Validates screen entries and writes new or modified draft data to the database.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: ecn_get (ENGINEERING CHANGE GET): Retrieves a single record using the unique document number.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: ecn_search (ENGINEERING CHANGE LIST): Calls up a search window to locate changes by component, status, or date range.

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r5.quote: ecn_approve (ENGINEERING CHANGE APPROVE): Applies formal technical sign-off to a saved draft.

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: ecn_release (ENGINEERING CHANGE RELEASE): Promotes an approved record to active status, making it live for production planning.

r7.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r7.quote: General database error during the ecn_save service, typically caused by missing mandatory header details or network disruption between the plant terminal and the server.

r8.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r8.quote: The current user profile lacks the authorisation level required to execute the ecn_approve service on this record.

r9.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf

r2.quote: Click the button marked pkb_save to execute the PRODUCTION KANBAN SAVE service. Ledgerline verifies the entered data against active system registers. Upon successful validation, the system generates a unique reference, displays it in the PKB NO field, and sets the card status to registered.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r3.loc_text: p. 70, Logging a new replenishment signal
r3.quote: Click the button marked pkb_signal to execute the PRODUCTION KANBAN SIGNAL service. Ledgerline immediately posts the demand to the replenishment queue of the feeding work centre, flags the electronic card as active, and logs the transaction against the current shift ledger.

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-PRD-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Production and Quality v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: Click the button for pkb_save (PRODUCTION KANBAN SAVE). Ledgerline validates the item against the current bill of materials and creates the electronic kanban record.

conflicts.today: The formal service definitions and error manuals define the specific validation failure codes (ERR-WO-0105 for date in past, ERR-WO-0201 for quantity must be > 0, ERR-WO-0310 for component shortage, ERR-WO-0007 for work order not released, ERR-WO-0801 for work order closed) across wo_save, wo_release, wo_close, and wo_cancel.
conflicts.other: The user manual narrative describes conflicting or transposed error codes for these conditions, such as ERR-WO-0105 for sequence exhaustion or stock shortage, ERR-WO-0201 for stock reservation failure or unposted movements, ERR-WO-0310 for unresolved scrap bookings or missing cancellation reasons, and ERR-WO-0007 for missing save fields or orders already processing.

r2.quote: Screen SAL-EDI-13, menu Sales > Edi messages. Services: edi_ord_in, edi_ord_ack, edi_desadv_out, edi_invoic_out, edi_err_list.

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: Press the edi_ord_in button. Ledgerline ERP 7.2 queries the electronic mailbox, reads the awaiting customer order files, translates the external data segments into internal sales records

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 constructs the outbound acknowledgement structure, pulling prices, delivery commitments, and scheduled plant locations directly from the accepted sales order lines.

r5.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r5.loc_text: p. 53, Generating outbound despatch advice notices
r5.quote: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 interrogates the completed despatch records, bundles the parcel details, carrier references, and delivery addresses into the standardised electronic despatch advice format

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 reads the finalised sales ledger billing run, extracts the tax totals, net figures, and currency details, and generates the outbound electronic invoice message.

r7.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf

r8.quote: Press the button rma_approve. Ledgerline ERP invokes the service WARRANTY RETURN (RMA) APPROVE. The system confirms your authorisation authority. Upon success, Ledgerline ERP updates the field STATUS

r11.quote: The service WARRANTY RETURN (RMA) RECEIVE must be executed successfully before the service WARRANTY RETURN (RMA) CLOSE can be accepted.

sop-ap-001.title: SOP-AP-001 Three-Way Invoice Matching
sop-ap-001.summary: Standard operating procedure governing automated three-way matching of supplier purchase invoices against orders and delivery records before payment release.
sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf

r1.loc_text: sheet Error codes, row ERR-MAT-0410, SHEET Error codes
r1.quote: ERR-MAT-0410 | message=MATCH FAILED: PRICE OUTSIDE TOLERANCE | module=MAT
